systems.title: Reference and development scope

rules.statement: Source-hobby function, RRR translation and new extension are separate fields.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Trace a mechanic before adding it.
rules.observable_consequence: A tank is not falsely attributed to PCR; a muscle still has a motor-related purpose.

rules.statement: The same trait identifier must connect field observations, breeding goals, accepted products and controlled performance tests.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Change a trait once and inspect all dependents.
rules.observable_consequence: A breeding improvement cannot secretly become an unrelated race bonus.

rules.statement: No fixed scoring weights, grade boundaries or acronym expansion are invented for MIVIM.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Use recovered guardrails and separate criterion findings.
rules.observable_consequence: Unsupported numerical grades are absent.

rules.statement: Conventional validation work protects the novel contribution but cannot substitute for it.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Report contribution role and evidence at its own scope.
rules.observable_consequence: A schema test is not claimed as delivered gameplay innovation.

rules.statement: All new numeric profiles are named revisioned fixtures; existing nulls remain unresolved outside that profile.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a profile explicitly.
rules.observable_consequence: A hopper test duration does not become every insect species lifecycle.

rules.statement: Original user premises outrank generated handbooks; new waves do not silently promote proposals into canon.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Resolve conflicts with authority and explicit amendments.
rules.observable_consequence: Open remains open; any hobbyist may catch and breed.

systems.title: Project-led intake and evidence

rules.statement: A project names a desired product or specimen use, target traits, current evidence, missing complement and spending or capacity limit.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Create a sprint, breeding, supply or collection project.
rules.observable_consequence: The player can explain why an animal is useful before keeping it.

rules.statement: A complementary breeder is judged against the current project, not solely its own aggregate race performance.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Retain a low-return high-synchrony hopper for a high-return line.
rules.observable_consequence: An otherwise ordinary capture may advance a specific breeding objective.

rules.statement: Intake recommendations read only the observations and knowledge visible to that decision maker.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Inspect, test or buy knowledge.
rules.observable_consequence: Two unseen genotypes with the same visible evidence receive the same default recommendation.

rules.statement: An observation records protocol, condition, load, stage, value bounds, time and method; bounds are not called confidence intervals without a model.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Compare compatible measurements.
rules.observable_consequence: A field glimpse and controlled assay remain visibly different evidence.

rules.statement: A demonstrated match, possible match and ruled-out target are distinct; unknown is not zero or automatic success.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Review uncertainty instead of accepting a fabricated exact answer.
rules.observable_consequence: A possible useful donor is flagged, not certified.

rules.statement: Explicit founder, replacement, collectible and order protections precede bulk sale recommendations.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Set or release a protection deliberately.
rules.observable_consequence: Quick-sale previews exclude protected stock.

rules.statement: Possible project matches request review without creating permanent unremovable locks.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Snooze a project, dismiss a match or override the current batch.
rules.observable_consequence: A full holding case can be cleared without deleting the whole project.

rules.statement: The quick route permits buying a coordinated kit and racing; assay and breeding are optional activities.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose the depth of participation.
rules.observable_consequence: Basic participation does not require learning allele notation.

rules.statement: Prices reflect buyer purpose and available evidence, not a hidden exact-genotype price oracle.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a buyer or better evidence for a sale.
rules.observable_consequence: Unidentified stock can be sold honestly as unidentified.

rules.statement: Run planning stores target donor, stage, habitat, observable sign, capture method, space, ordinary-stock outlet and source of the claim.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a purposeful route.
rules.observable_consequence: A trip has a useful ordinary result as well as exceptional targets, without guaranteed profit.

systems.title: Selection and phenotype production

rules.statement: The Wave 03 witness uses three independent diploid hopper loci for return, synchrony and settling; it does not generalize to colony donors.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Apply the named fixture only to its declared scope.
rules.observable_consequence: Unavailable colony formulas stay unavailable.

rules.statement: Offspring inherit one allele per parent per locus in this fixture; mutation, linkage and reproductive failure are separately configured, not implied.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose parents with complementary contributions.
rules.observable_consequence: The support of possible offspring is enumerable and does not default to parental maxima.

rules.statement: Genotype potential, developmental expression, current condition, preparation and mounting remain separate records.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Correct the relevant cause of a disappointing result.
rules.observable_consequence: Remounting a part does not rewrite its pedigree.

rules.statement: A founder contribution may matter across generations even when first-generation offspring do not meet the final target.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose immediate donor use versus intermediate breeding stock.
rules.observable_consequence: A failed premium target can still produce useful ordinary assemblies.

rules.statement: Breeding forecasts state what they are conditional on, including initiated count, survival, assay and delivery window.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Decide whether a forecast supports a promise.
rules.observable_consequence: A conditional one-in-sixteen genotype chance is never shown as a guaranteed sale rate.

rules.statement: Project forecasts use compatible observations or explicit tested genotype knowledge; engine-truth enumeration is a debug witness, not default UI.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Acquire relevant evidence rather than access omniscient suggestions.
rules.observable_consequence: The breeder panel can state insufficient evidence.

rules.statement: A demonstrated line claim names protocol, trait acceptance, tested count, brood identities and dates; one winning racer does not certify a line.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Publish a narrow reproducibility claim.
rules.observable_consequence: Customers can distinguish a sample observation from a guarantee.

rules.statement: Fertility, initiated young, surviving young, saleable young and retained replacements are counted separately.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Improve the bottleneck the business actually has.
rules.observable_consequence: A larger clutch may not increase saleable output.

rules.statement: A project may target production reliability or appearance instead of maximal race output.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Breed for wholesale, collection or a competitive build.
rules.observable_consequence: Modest racing stock can be the preferred commercial parent.

rules.statement: Each batch has a stable event-local outcome seed in the implementation witness; unrelated actions and view refreshes do not reroll it.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Replay or inspect without changing ancestry.
rules.observable_consequence: Splitting a clock advance does not change the cohort.

systems.title: Future capacity and delayed cohorts

rules.statement: A production commitment reserves identified parents, mating time, incubation, grow-out, transition space and planned output handling.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Inspect the full path before starting another brood.
rules.observable_consequence: An empty mating compartment does not conceal full future grow-out.

rules.statement: Capacity claims use resource-specific physical or declared fixture units and half-open intervals [start,end).
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Compare overlapping occupancy on the same resource.
rules.observable_consequence: A departing cohort and arriving cohort can share a boundary without double occupancy.

rules.statement: The safe preset reserves the bounded initiated cohort count, not merely expected survivors; risk-taking overflow plans must name actual capacity or services.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Pay for capacity or accept a declared alternative.
rules.observable_consequence: A probability forecast cannot manufacture physical space.

rules.statement: A multi-resource reservation commits atomically or not at all.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Attempt a new plan.
rules.observable_consequence: Failure does not strand a parent reservation or consume half the supplies.

rules.statement: A delay to a living cohort preserves the actual animals and their occupancy.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Reschedule later production or acquire overflow.
rules.observable_consequence: Living young are not deleted because a spreadsheet says their stage ended.

rules.statement: When a delay conflicts only with unstarted jobs, pause those whole jobs and release their unspent reservations for replanning.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Review which future contracts require revision.
rules.observable_consequence: No unstarted job retains hidden partial resources.

rules.statement: A conflict between two existing living cohorts requires actual relocation or other declared handling; the witness refuses to pretend that pausing resolves it.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Arrange supported overflow or a stated consequence.
rules.observable_consequence: The unimplemented relocation path is flagged, not silently credited as safe.

rules.statement: Starting costs, ongoing care, deadlines, maturation and actual settlement use the same world clock.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Race, travel or fast-forward while production operates.
rules.observable_consequence: Waiting advances costs as well as opportunities.

rules.statement: Default offline behavior remains paused world time; no return schedule is imposed.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Leave the game without maintaining a real-world appointment.
rules.observable_consequence: Real time alone does not kill or feed stock in the default branch.

rules.statement: Mature stock still needs holding; storage and replacement space remain obligations after grow-out.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Reserve output handling rather than ending the schedule at maturity.
rules.observable_consequence: Production completion does not free space occupied by unsold animals.

rules.statement: Pausing new production does not pause care for existing stock.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Protect working capital or pay for help.
rules.observable_consequence: A stopped business remains responsible for living inventory.

systems.title: Anatomy, components and kit assembly

rules.statement: An anatomy token identifies a physical donor region; extraction transfers it from that individual to a prepared component.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a harvest plan.
rules.observable_consequence: The same hind joint cannot remain simultaneously on the live donor and in a kit.

rules.statement: A complete multi-role assembly contributes its physical structures once, regardless of the number of functional roles it covers.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Use a whole Hopper set or a subassembly.
rules.observable_consequence: Hind limbs, jump and landing roles do not multiply mass, price or stock count.

rules.statement: Alternative harvest plans sharing anatomy are exclusive; disjoint plans can coexist.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose a complete hopper or separated joint product; allocate scarab tissues independently where possible.
rules.observable_consequence: One donor can supply several honest products without duplicated loot.

rules.statement: Protected parents require explicit release before irreversible preparation.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Trade future reproductive value for immediate use deliberately.
rules.observable_consequence: Automation cannot casually consume the sole retained founder.

rules.statement: Vital extraction changes the donor living state; nonvital extraction still changes anatomy and condition.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Select the preparation and retained stock.
rules.observable_consequence: A body record surviving in the database is not proof its animal remains intact.

rules.statement: A packaged kit owns custody of its components; loose-component sale or installation first requires a declared unpack operation.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Keep, sell, unpack or assemble the kit.
rules.observable_consequence: A packaged part cannot be sold separately while the kit remains complete.

rules.statement: Buying a kit transfers its real contents and recipe; assembly remains an actual sequence using those contents.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Place and fit the parts personally or use the supported guided process.
rules.observable_consequence: A purchased tin is not an instant unearned assembled racer.

rules.statement: Installation changes component custody and the named host configuration, not its germline.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Fit a new graft.
rules.observable_consequence: The host retains identity and its inherited genome.

rules.statement: Geometry feasibility and event legality are separate, capability-based results.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Solve interference or choose another legal event.
rules.observable_consequence: Horn-and-foil combinations are not banned by a returning one-brow-slot rule.

rules.statement: A failed multi-asset commit leaves ownership, money and custody unchanged.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Correct the missing item and retry.
rules.observable_consequence: No partial kit or sale is silently committed.

systems.title: Funded orders and earned operating margin

rules.statement: A firm standing order reserves actual buyer funds for its remaining accepted quantity.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Accept a funded commitment rather than an unfunded asking price.
rules.observable_consequence: A visible order has a finite budget; escrow is not seller revenue.

rules.statement: A casual spot sale can settle immediately; the standing-order path does not add compulsory waiting to every transaction.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose immediate sale or production contracting.
rules.observable_consequence: The ordinary return-and-sell loop remains accessible.

rules.statement: Order acceptance uses product identity, declared evidence and condition policy; engine-hidden genotype is not an undeclared acceptance requirement.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Test, substitute by agreement or sell in another channel.
rules.observable_consequence: A known ordinary product can be accepted without pedigree certification.

rules.statement: Delivery transfers accepted assets and payment together; repeated event IDs replay the original receipt without a second payment.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Commit or retry a delivery.
rules.observable_consequence: Reloading or double-clicking cannot generate extra income.

rules.statement: A repeated transaction key with a different payload is rejected.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Submit a genuinely new action with a new identity.
rules.observable_consequence: Retries cannot be repurposed into unlogged changes.

rules.statement: Remaining escrow returns to the buyer when the order closes under its cancellation terms.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Cancel or settle the outstanding obligation.
rules.observable_consequence: Unspent funds do not become a cancellation profit.

rules.statement: Delivery at the stated final tick is valid before end-of-tick expiry; transport arrival is not assumed at dispatch.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Plan arrival rather than merely shipment.
rules.observable_consequence: Deadline boundaries have one reproducible interpretation.

rules.statement: Cash received, operating payments, unsold stock, retained productive stock, earmarks and capital purchases are distinct quantities.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose reinvestment while preserving care money.
rules.observable_consequence: A brood summary cannot count a retained breeder as both sale and inventory.

rules.statement: A product sale uses a funded customer; market replenishment requires a declared demand and budget source outside the closed fixture.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Find recurring customers or new markets.
rules.observable_consequence: Advancing time alone does not replenish every buyer wallet infinitely.

rules.statement: Cash planning includes incurred and future care; inability to start a new brood does not erase current obligations.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Hold a working reserve, reduce new starts or buy services.
rules.observable_consequence: An advertised margin does not imply affordable growth.

rules.statement: Low quality relative to one project can still have ordinary kit, service or collector demand; no universal profitable outlet is guaranteed.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose the relevant buyer or retain stock.
rules.observable_consequence: Selling surplus is useful without turning every animal into fixed cash.

rules.statement: Every monetary figure in the supplied integration is a fixture with initial assets and omitted costs disclosed.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Use it to check consistency, not predict final profits.
rules.observable_consequence: A positive single cohort is not declared a sustainable economy.

systems.title: Trait-to-part and part-to-run contracts

rules.statement: The reference-hobby distinction between drive output, leverage, contact and handling remains explicit.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose components affecting the intended mechanical variable.
rules.observable_consequence: A horn is not renamed as a motor; foot grip does not invent energy.

rules.statement: Each controlled comparison fixes host mass, reserve, surface, configuration and protocol except the stated changed input.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Compare a donor change or tuning action.
rules.observable_consequence: Measured changes are attributed to a declared cause.

rules.statement: The hopper fixture maps return to useful launch energy, timing error to transfer loss and settling tissue to recovery time.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Breed and fit the desired combination.
rules.observable_consequence: A selected assembly can improve several results at the same input energy.

rules.statement: Mounting error is a setup term separate from inherited timing.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Align a useful donor correctly.
rules.observable_consequence: A remount changes the result without improving its genes.

rules.statement: Drive cadence and stall force feed a loaded one-dimensional bench; leverage changes force and free stride speed in opposite directions.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Try a faster motor or different hip geometry.
rules.observable_consequence: A new drive can demonstrably run the same bench faster.

rules.statement: Shared delivery is allocated across simultaneous demands; no organ receives the whole supply independently.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Configure priorities or supply capacity in the eventual runtime.
rules.observable_consequence: Requested outputs cannot exceed declared delivery together.

rules.statement: Normalized fixtures have explicit units, input bounds and protocol versions; they are not claims about real insect scale.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Replace coefficients through calibration without rewriting history.
rules.observable_consequence: No physical speed or jump height is falsely asserted.

rules.statement: A component test is not a race result; the eventual course simulation must consume the same accepted trait contract.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Validate actual racing separately.
rules.observable_consequence: No fixture automatically grants a win, qualification or trophy.

rules.statement: Genuine improvements remain permitted without obligatory drawbacks.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Keep an exceptionally useful find.
rules.observable_consequence: Equal-mass, equal-input improvement is not arbitrarily weakened to force a tradeoff.

rules.statement: The ordinary purchase route can obtain the same functional quality as breeding; different acquisition routes change history and cost, not hidden performance multipliers.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Buy, find or breed a good component.
rules.observable_consequence: A shop customer is not made intrinsically inferior to a breeder.

systems.title: Interaction and presentation contracts

rules.statement: The intake primary view has Keep, Review and Sale-candidate groups with a short reason for each assignment.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Handle a mixed case quickly.
rules.observable_consequence: Useful decisions are visible before advanced numbers.

rules.statement: Expert inspection expands observations, parentage evidence, anatomy, stage and project match without navigating to a disconnected application.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Investigate a promising specimen.
rules.observable_consequence: Depth is optional but immediately related to the same animal.

rules.statement: A brood card states current stage, next transition, live occupancy, future occupancy, reserved replacements and the first blocking condition.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Fix the actual constraint.
rules.observable_consequence: Full grow-out is not mislabeled as no breeding slot.

rules.statement: An earnings card shows received, spent, outstanding, retained and available-after-planned-care separately.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Choose reinvestment or a safer reserve.
rules.observable_consequence: Expected income is never styled as already spendable cash.

rules.statement: Batch actions preview affected identities and protections; routine care operates through chosen presets or services.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Approve a useful batch rather than repeat individual feeding clicks.
rules.observable_consequence: Large operations add strategic planning rather than proportional click burden.

rules.statement: Breeder marks, donor lineage, prepared anatomy and build identity remain visible in product cards and finished racers.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Recognize and show the part that was earned.
rules.observable_consequence: The biological hobby identity survives optimization and batch processing.

rules.statement: A beautiful unusual specimen can be kept by preference without a racing justification; presentation and provenance have first-class fields.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Collect or finish a distinctive build.
rules.observable_consequence: The world is not reduced to one numeric optimizer.

rules.statement: No visual/usability polish is credited as rendered or playtested in this wave.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Carry the interaction specification to the next implementation.
rules.observable_consequence: Design ambition remains open rather than a text-only mockup being called finished UI.

systems.title: Versioning, testing and handoff

rules.statement: Append Wave 03 under development_waves and preserve all prior base records unchanged in canonical JSON content; retain the baseline file verbatim.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Load base history plus new records.
rules.observable_consequence: Existing IDs, source notes, seed records and old results do not disappear.

rules.statement: Each refinement names the prior rule or record; a active-view projection may select current versions without editing stored history.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Revise a field or predicate intentionally.
rules.observable_consequence: Catalogue changes cannot silently reroll stock.

rules.statement: Test structural integrity, adversarial operations, controlled mechanisms and complete gameplay as distinct evidence categories.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Report exactly what was run.
rules.observable_consequence: A model witness is not sold as a playable game.

rules.statement: Unknown quality or novelty findings cannot be compensated by more passed tests, lower complexity or faster output.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Keep the appropriate acceptance gate open.
rules.observable_consequence: No weighted average erases a hard guardrail failure.

rules.statement: The next primary task connects these same traits to an assembled racer on modular circuits with real outcomes, not an unrelated scoring layer.
rules.player_or_agent_decision: Continue the development graph.
rules.observable_consequence: The supply game remains accountable to exciting racing.

invariants: No global best-insect score replaces purpose.
Protocol-incompatible results cannot certify a selected order.
Future occupancy is not expected sales.
One physical region has one current location.
Complete assemblies and subparts do not create duplicate matter.
Only accepted delivered units earn receipts.
Escrow plus accounts is conserved in the closed witness.
A fixture is not physical calibration.

Capacity uses normalized stage-specific slots; live-cohort overflow relocation, staff and climate are not implemented.

Prepared-sect pack and simple installation custody, not geometric integration or removal/storage runtime.

Two controlled normalized benches, not multiplayer/AI races, collision, weapons, track layouts or player controls.
Interaction specifications only; no rendered UI, animation, visual-grade claim or player retention evidence.

operational_projects.resident_evidence: High return demonstrated; synchrony is the missing complement.
operational_projects.field_objective: Find unrelated hopper stock with repeatable paired release; observe short hops and preserve both hind limbs.
operational_projects.keep_logic: A lower-return animal with demonstrated synchrony may be more useful than another high-return animal with the same deficiency.
operational_projects.sell_or_use_logic: Intermediate offspring can supply ordinary hopper assemblies; protect future parents and selected personal builds first.
operational_projects.knowledge_boundary: Target values are fixture protocol thresholds; exact hidden alleles are not shown by default.
operational_projects.witness: Genotype support and public routing are checked separately; no omniscient automatic mating optimizer is claimed.

operational_projects.use: supply four ordinary hopper assemblies while preserving the line
operational_projects.keep_logic: Protect replacements and the deliberate personal upgrade before allocating deliverable donor anatomy.
operational_projects.witness: Predetermined eight-survivor cohort; does not estimate probability of fulfilling the order.

operational_projects.use: purchase or produce a genuinely faster drive
acquisition: breed and rear using a complete life-stage facility
operational_projects.selection_reason: Loaded cadence and useful force, not loudness or body size; drive and hip leverage remain distinct.
operational_projects.witness: Part-to-bench comparison checked; cicada genetics, lifecycle and real racing remain outside this witness.

polish_backlog.issue: Expected income, real cash and retained stock can appear as one reward total.

systems.title: The same specimen becomes the racing part

rules.statement: Compile a racer from one host, actual installed component identities, native anatomy, preparation and a saved setup.
rules.decision: Fit parts, then enter that configuration.
rules.observable: Purchase alone does not change racing performance.

rules.statement: An acquired part only changes a build after installation; acquisition history grants no hidden multiplier.
rules.decision: Buy, catch or breed a useful donor.
rules.observable: Equivalent finished anatomy performs equivalently under equal conditions.

rules.statement: A drive contributes cadence and useful force; leverage changes their delivery rather than adding a second motor.
rules.decision: Choose drive stock and hip geometry separately.
rules.observable: Acceleration and sustained pace change through the named variables.

rules.statement: A hopper contributes inherited return, phase and settling; preload and alignment remain builder choices.
rules.decision: Breed a better pair or remount the existing pair.
rules.observable: The comparison identifies which layer changed.

rules.statement: A multi-role graft contributes mass, tissue and capability once.
rules.decision: Keep a whole package or separate its subcomponents.
rules.observable: A hopper can serve jump and suspension roles without two free assemblies.

rules.statement: Race entry captures an immutable build snapshot and model/rules/course versions.
rules.decision: Commit the intended setup before the start.
rules.observable: Later edits do not alter an old win, trophy or provenance claim.

rules.statement: Normalized values remain local test profiles; absolute creature scale is not established by the solver.
rules.decision: Calibrate scale separately.
rules.observable: No normalized time is advertised as real seconds or a retail product guarantee.

systems.title: Club benches, borrowing and personal assembly

rules.statement: A club bench supplies tools, fixtures, space and advice, not an exclusive right to modify a roach.
rules.decision: Use home facilities, a club bay or a paid fitting service.
rules.observable: Casual access and expert ownership coexist.

rules.statement: A test loan changes custody of a particular component for an agreed session.
rules.decision: Try a motor-equivalent before buying.
rules.observable: One component cannot be on the shop display and two test racers simultaneously.

rules.statement: A comparison ticket identifies fixed conditions, changed components and intended measurements.
rules.decision: Compare a drive replacement or a preload change.
rules.observable: An observed result is attributable to a stated experiment, not a universal best-build score.

rules.statement: Guided kit assembly shows the actual parts, placement and incorporation; advanced adjustment remains on the same objects.
rules.decision: Assemble the tin or modify its recipe.
rules.observable: The beginner still builds their own racer.

rules.statement: A failed fitting previews blocked motion, inadequate support or an event conflict separately.
rules.decision: Move the graft, alter support or select an eligible event.
rules.observable: No universal one-brow-slot rule returns.

rules.statement: A fitting commission states desired outcome, supplied stock, labor, testing and revision terms.
rules.decision: Earn money through assembly expertise.
rules.observable: Professional work can improve execution without secretly improving donor genetics.

rules.statement: A loan return or service completion records actual condition; new loss rules cannot be introduced retroactively.
rules.decision: Accept known terms before handing over valued stock.
rules.observable: Service income does not depend on surprise confiscation or mandatory permadeath.

systems.title: Modular courses that support a modular hobby

rules.statement: A section defines inlet and outlet pose, width, surface, usable paths, supports and active clearance.
rules.decision: Assemble valid connected pieces.
rules.observable: A track is both geometry and ordered travel, not a bag of section names.

rules.statement: An installed course uses owned or borrowed section instances and a separate layout recipe.
rules.decision: Pool, hire, buy or rearrange track pieces.
rules.observable: A plan does not spawn the physical course.

rules.statement: Passing space is authored as track geometry; guided and shared sections are both valid formats.
rules.decision: Build a technical channel or a broad pack circuit.
rules.observable: Contact opportunities follow the actual layout.

rules.statement: Alternative routes declare their entry, exit, required gates and locomotion conditions.
rules.decision: Choose a legitimate jump or climbing route.
rules.observable: Route freedom does not silently skip mandatory course progress.

rules.statement: Inside and outside paths have different physical distances when geometry makes them different.
rules.decision: Take an inside line or a clear outside pass.
rules.observable: Lateral position affects both distance and maneuvering; no artificial equal-distance assumption.

rules.statement: A repeated qualifying format can rotate start assignments; a single experimental grid is not proof of competitive fairness.
rules.decision: Choose published heat and seeding procedures.
rules.observable: Grid advantage is assessed instead of hidden.

rules.statement: Surface wear and cleaning change declared contact conditions only when that system is present.
rules.decision: Maintain a venue or prepare suitable feet.
rules.observable: The course does not receive arbitrary invisible difficulty multipliers.

rules.statement: A layout revision creates a new record category while retaining historic times under their original layout.
rules.decision: Modify a famous circuit and set new records.
rules.observable: An old champion is not retroactively disqualified by a later rebuild.

systems.title: Pace, passing, contact and the finish

rules.statement: Running output uses loaded drive, energy delivery, traction, body mass and leverage.
rules.decision: Improve the desired mechanical contribution.
rules.observable: Pace emerges from motion integration rather than a hidden race-power score.

rules.statement: A passing maneuver identifies available space, commits to a side and recenters after clearance.
rules.decision: Attempt a pass rather than repeatedly steering toward and away from the same rival.
rules.observable: The racer follows through on an observable overtaking attempt.

rules.statement: Hopper loading and locomotion share current reserve and delivery; released energy is not spent twice.
rules.decision: Choose preload and timing.
rules.observable: An active maneuver has a real resource cost before its benefit.

rules.statement: A jump uses inherited tissue and setup to determine useful energy, trajectory and recovery.
rules.decision: Change the donor, preload, alignment or route.
rules.observable: A better spring is not a guaranteed pass at every speed or clearance.

rules.statement: A horn attack requires reachable aligned contact after wind-up; a miss consumes the declared commitment.
rules.decision: Build and use a useful ram geometry.
rules.observable: No remote damage is awarded from an attack rating.

rules.statement: A grasping response has closure delay, reach, hold and recovery; holding can impede both racers.
rules.decision: Intercept a committed rival or release to resume racing.
rules.observable: Claws create a racing decision rather than a permanent disable.

rules.statement: Native contact and dedicated weapons are different capabilities; Speedsters permits the former and excludes the latter.
rules.decision: Select the intended division.
rules.observable: Weapon legality is not decided by cosmetic naming.

rules.statement: Recovery states preserve course location and elapsed time.
rules.decision: Regain motion through existing anatomy or supported intervention.
rules.observable: Falling behind is a racing consequence; the game does not silently reset position.

rules.statement: Finish classification requires the full ordered course; ties and nonfinishers have declared handling.
rules.decision: Complete the race.
rules.observable: Neither damage count nor a bench result grants victory.

rules.statement: The simulation reads inherited internal properties; public advice and commercial claims read only acquired evidence.
rules.decision: Observe, test and disclose selectively.
rules.observable: Mechanical correctness does not create an omniscient shopping interface.

systems.title: The event is a funded operation

rules.statement: A meeting names venue, layout, locomotion, equipment policy, format, entry conditions and qualification consequences independently.
rules.decision: Enter an appropriate local race or qualifier.
rules.observable: Open is build freedom; local participation is not automatic World City admission.

rules.statement: A practice run can award a local record or rival acknowledgement without creating a cash prize.
rules.decision: Practice freely or enter a funded event.
rules.observable: Replay and practice do not print tournament money.

rules.statement: Prize commitments name entry receipts, sponsor funds, club funds or other declared backing.
rules.decision: Host an event at a sustainable size.
rules.observable: Prize money is transferred once from an identifiable budget.

rules.statement: Tied placements share the affected prize allocation under published terms.
rules.decision: Resolve a dead heat.
rules.observable: An identifier or iteration order does not select the richer winner.

rules.statement: Operational payments fund actual hosting activities separately from race prizes.
rules.decision: Provide timing, track setup, staffing or facility services.
rules.observable: Trackmakers and hosts can earn a keep without winning races.

rules.statement: A sanctioned result stores the named host, build snapshot, finish and course.
rules.decision: Keep a trophy, publish a record or enter the next qualifier.
rules.observable: A racer retains a career across equipment changes.

rules.statement: Replays, photographs and subsequent comparisons reference the original result without recommitting its transactions.
rules.decision: Revisit a race or share its build.
rules.observable: Watching a win twice does not pay twice.

rules.statement: A race winner is not automatically a genetically certified breeding line.
rules.decision: Celebrate the win and offer an appropriately qualified claim.
rules.observable: Prestige can generate attention without fabricating inherited guarantees.

systems.title: Race attention becomes specific hobby demand

rules.statement: A viewer notices a visible performance or appearance; an inquiry precedes a purchase unless a standing agreement already exists.
rules.decision: Demonstrate, advertise or decline to disclose.
rules.observable: Publicity is an opportunity, not instant sale revenue.

rules.statement: A trial order states the useful component, observable acceptance criteria and funded quantity.
rules.decision: Sell a small credible batch before promising a major run.
rules.observable: The buyer purchases a specified assembly, not a promise that every child wins.

rules.statement: A buyer pays for performance, fit, consistency, availability, appearance or provenance according to its purpose.
rules.decision: Choose the appropriate market for retained and surplus stock.
rules.observable: Different customers can value the same cohort differently.

rules.statement: Funded inquiries compete for actual supply and production capacity; growing young remain future inventory.
rules.decision: Allocate stock among personal builds, founders, ordinary sales and commissions.
rules.observable: Commercial success creates meaningful allocation choices.

rules.statement: Consignment retains the consignor identity until a real sale; fees and custody are explicit.
rules.decision: Use a shop to reach customers without selling outright.
rules.observable: Shelf price and shop possession do not become realized seller income.

rules.statement: Recurring demand depends on customer activity and budgets outside the breeding tank.
rules.decision: Serve kit buyers, collectors, racers, clubs and traders.
rules.observable: No rule assumes that fresh animals are needed only because every race destroys them.

rules.statement: Ordinary paid services and common-stock buyers remain accessible recovery routes.
rules.decision: Earn modest income after a failed ambitious project.
rules.observable: A major race loss need not force a second career or wipe the workshop.

rules.statement: A broader economy may aggregate ordinary household spending, but its replenishment must be declared and bounded.
rules.decision: Scale the world without simulating every citizen at full fidelity.
rules.observable: Aggregate customers still have accountable expenditure rather than infinite wallets.

systems.title: Performance questions lead back into the wildlands

rules.statement: Race symptoms identify candidate explanations, not unique hidden genetic diagnoses.
rules.decision: Check fuel, condition, setup and comparable assays before replacing a lineage.
rules.observable: Late fading does not automatically mean poor inherited endurance.

rules.statement: A targeted run links the missing contribution to a donor, stage, habitat and inspectable sign.
rules.decision: Pursue loaded cadence, release timing, wing integrity or a particular appearance.
rules.observable: The trip has a stated use without guaranteed rarity.

rules.statement: A currently useful founder can be an ordinary performer that supplies the missing inherited complement.
rules.decision: Retain synchronized hoppers for a high-return line.
rules.observable: Field selection uses the current project, not only the finished-product cutoff.

rules.statement: The same route can supply several disjoint customer needs and personal interests.
rules.decision: Return with common pads, selected arms or attractive moths.
rules.observable: Unwanted for one racer does not mean worthless to every customer.

rules.statement: Published demand changes which traits a catcher seeks, not which genes already captured animals possess.
rules.decision: Revisit known habitats for previously ignored characteristics.
rules.observable: A new race trend cannot reroll existing specimens.

rules.statement: Population recovery, stage changes and travel use world time; entering a screen is not a new cohort.
rules.decision: Choose another route, breed, trade or wait under the declared clock.
rules.observable: Rare searching remains an activity rather than a reload exploit.

systems.title: Breeding, stage timing and race-season commitments

rules.statement: A seasonal supply plan schedules brood, target stage, preparation, transport and receipt against an event or customer date.
rules.decision: Choose which project can mature in time.
rules.observable: A useful specimen arriving after the final is a different commercial proposition.

rules.statement: Ordinary intermediary output and retained replacements can support a premium project simultaneously.
rules.decision: Sell useful stock while continuing selective work.
rules.observable: Selection need not wait for a perfect genotype before earning anything.

rules.statement: Stage-specific products use an actual developmental window, not a generic adult rarity upgrade.
rules.decision: Produce Clockleaf couplings at the useful stage while retaining reproductive adults.
rules.observable: An adult-only enclosure cannot supply every stage on demand.

rules.statement: Preparation and storage windows remain product-specific; frozen future output cannot be sold as ready stock.
rules.decision: Prepare near delivery or pay for supported preservation.
rules.observable: Storage services change scheduling, not inherited quality.

rules.statement: A line claim includes tested offspring, brood identities, protocol and date.
rules.decision: Sell reliability backed by observed batches.
rules.observable: One famous installed pair does not certify every descendant.

rules.statement: Race attendance advances the same broader world obligations when the clocks are integrated.
rules.decision: Arrange care before a circuit trip.
rules.observable: The later runtime must advance production and upkeep together; the present race witness does not yet do so.

systems.title: Clubs, Wrangloids and rivals share the same world

rules.statement: Wrangloids combine finding, breeding, trading and expertise in different proportions; their profession is not an exclusive permission.
rules.decision: Become a supplier, customer, breeder or some combination.
rules.observable: Every person can attempt the underlying hobby activities.

rules.statement: An NPC racer has owned stock, available money, knowledge, preferred activities and an event schedule.
rules.decision: Compete, trade, lend, teach or commission work.
rules.observable: A rival does not conjure a perfect counterbuild from private player data.

rules.statement: NPC changes follow their observations and available opportunities, including shop stock and public build cards.
rules.decision: Demonstrate an idea or keep parts undisclosed.
rules.observable: The competitive scene can adapt without omniscience.

rules.statement: Club participation can provide shared tools, borrowed sections, introductions and practice partners.
rules.decision: Join for material and social benefits rather than a hidden stat aura.
rules.observable: A club matters even to a collector who does not campaign for the Derby.

rules.statement: Faction support differs through facilities, funded programs, supply contacts and representative selection.
rules.decision: Choose affiliations and opportunities.
rules.observable: Faction identity is not reduced to a palette swap or a universally superior gene.

rules.statement: Collectors, finishers, kit authors and track builders receive distinct credit.
rules.decision: Show a beautiful animal, sell a signature tin or host a remarkable layout.
rules.observable: Recognition is not exclusively awarded to the current fastest racer.

rules.statement: Advice, sale reputation, competition standing and lineage evidence are independent records.
rules.decision: Trust a reliable seller without assuming they are the best racer.
rules.observable: One popularity scalar does not replace every relationship.

systems.title: Visible changes, useful records and optional depth

rules.statement: Primary race presentation shows position, direction, major actions, remaining distance and the finish.
rules.decision: Watch the race as a sporting event.
rules.observable: Diagnostic detail does not displace excitement and readable competition.

rules.statement: A visible module signature accompanies its action: horn commitment, folding grasp, loaded hind limbs and landing compression.
rules.decision: Recognize the graft personally fitted.
rules.observable: The roach is not rendered as an identical marker with different stat text.

rules.statement: A result card shows placing and time first, followed by the actual build and optional component evidence.
rules.decision: Celebrate, compare or publish.
rules.observable: The victory is not reframed as merely solving a track.

rules.statement: Public build cards can disclose component identity without revealing hidden genes or unmeasured values.
rules.decision: Show off or keep a preparation detail private.
rules.observable: A photograph is not an omniscient assay.

rules.statement: A replay inspector links each major action to the fitted component and relevant preparation.
rules.decision: Inspect a pass or failed jump after watching it.
rules.observable: The evidence remains attached to the same asset rather than an unrelated tutorial page.

rules.statement: Replay controls do not mutate the underlying outcome, inventory, world clock or purse.
rules.decision: Scrub, pause and switch experiments.
rules.observable: Presentation does not rerun a payable event.

rules.statement: The delivered browser surface is an experimental replay viewer, not the editable kit bench or finished game.
rules.decision: Review the visible mechanism at its actual scope.
rules.observable: Unimplemented assembly and simulation controls are not represented by dead buttons.

operational_threads.name: Cadence that survives a real load
operational_threads.trigger: A build consistently accelerates more slowly under a matched load.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Compare fuel delivery, mass and leverage before interpreting the drive assay.
operational_threads.selection: Loaded cadence and usable force, not loudness.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Combine useful cadence with efficient output; retain productive founders.
operational_threads.customer: Club racers and coordinated kit authors.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Component upgrade demand supports adult stock sales and complete nursery investments.
operational_threads.limit: Race-model drive identity is implemented; cicada genetics are not.

operational_threads.name: A hopper line worth repeating
operational_threads.origin: PCR landing control plus RRR active jumping
operational_threads.trigger: A clean overtake succeeds, or landing recovery loses the gained position.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Separate launch preload, alignment and inherited phase/settling measurements.
operational_threads.selection: The missing synchronization or settling contribution, including ordinary-return candidates.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Build a joint return/synchrony/settling target across generations.
operational_threads.output: Prepared paired Hoppers; alternatively disassembled joints.
operational_threads.customer: Ordinary kit shop plus selected-component customers.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Intermediary stock funds continued selection while actual installed examples advertise the line.
operational_threads.limit: One observed pass supports that build, not guaranteed offspring success.

operational_threads.name: Grip that releases in time
operational_threads.trigger: Foot-slip or slow foot release appears in controlled running.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Compare the same surface, moisture, load and current cleanliness.
operational_threads.selection: Purchase plus fast peel release; keep attractive forms independently.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Combine complementary pad properties and select consistent usable pairs.
operational_threads.output: Sticktoe foot sets or alternative brake strips.
operational_threads.customer: Technical racers, brake makers and collectors.
operational_threads.world_consequence: A single route supports different buyers; no duplicate harvest of the same pads.
operational_threads.limit: Full foot gait is not in the current race solver.

operational_threads.name: The base transfers the charge
operational_threads.origin: RRR derby weapon, integrated with PCR frame support
operational_threads.trigger: A ram contacts but deflects or destabilizes its own support.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Inspect contact direction, root structure and support before blaming size.
operational_threads.where: Debris-covered compost margins on the Cooling-kiln route.
operational_threads.selection: Root strength and useful curvature rather than longest tip.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Combine a useful horn geometry with strong, consistent roots.
operational_threads.output: Bullhorn Ram and disjoint support products.
operational_threads.customer: Open or Fireworks builders and horn-form collectors.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Creates demand for breeders, preparation and structural fitting commissions.
operational_threads.limit: Root fracture and destructible anatomy remain unimplemented.

operational_threads.name: Closure before the rival escapes
operational_threads.trigger: A grasp winds up but closes after the target has passed.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Compare actual reach, closure response and target alignment.
operational_threads.where: Glasshouse vertical scrub and stable perches.
operational_threads.selection: Useful reach while retaining fast closure.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Outcross reach and closure contributions without relying on body size.
operational_threads.customer: Open and Fireworks racers; legal brace buyers.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Predator compartments and careful transport earn value through intact useful arms.
operational_threads.limit: Current claw operator is a contact-delay proxy, not articulated limb physics.

operational_threads.name: The useful juvenile is the product
operational_threads.origin: PCR synchronization plus RRR life stages
operational_threads.trigger: A repeat order requests matched couplings before a meeting.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Verify stage, current function and delivery window rather than buying the largest adults.
operational_threads.where: Pond/reed route during the declared cohort window.
operational_threads.selection: Precision plus a practical usable-stage window.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Retain adult founders and schedule juvenile output separately.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Creates stage-specific orders and preservation demand without forcing real-world login schedules.
operational_threads.limit: A complete numerical lifecycle and storage window remain queued.

operational_threads.name: An intact wing supply
operational_threads.origin: RRR Flyers with PCR power/handling functions
operational_threads.trigger: Flyer clients request efficient matched wing-root assemblies.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Distinguish damage, fit, drive supply and repeatable root response.
operational_threads.where: Cooling ponds with clear emergence supports.
operational_threads.selection: Wing efficiency, root endurance and intact expansion.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Track parents through aquatic young and emergence rather than adult-only cages.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Pond breeders, protected carriers and fitting workshops all have paid roles.
operational_threads.limit: Sustained flight is not simulated in this wave.

operational_threads.name: Desirable without a race justification
operational_threads.origin: PCR finishing and collectible kit culture
operational_threads.trigger: A customer wants a distinctive visible form or finish.
operational_threads.next_evidence: Record appearance, provenance and condition; do not invent superior race traits.
operational_threads.where: Sheltered textile ruins and nearby vegetation.
operational_threads.selection: The requested markings or structure, not a generic rarity color.
operational_threads.breeding_objective: Select the appearance goal while preserving viable reproduction.
operational_threads.output: Whole display stock, prepared vanes or signature presentation kit.
operational_threads.world_consequence: Aesthetics produces collection value and optional livelihoods alongside racing.
operational_threads.limit: No formula for player aesthetic preference is claimed.

service_contracts.receipt: physical kit transferred; assembly still player-led
service_contracts.purpose: turn repeatable line quality into an approachable product

service_contracts.inputs: declared buying budget and product acceptance
service_contracts.purpose: connect publicity to credible buying without a genetic guarantee

service_contracts.inputs: retained founders, facility capacity, care, acceptance target
service_contracts.receipt: accepted stock; unsold young remain obligations
service_contracts.purpose: earn through productive consistency, not only top race stats

service_contracts.service: result reporting and optional build feature
service_contracts.inputs: verified event and permission to publish components
service_contracts.purpose: fame spreads through information, not hidden global bonuses

entity_extensions.purpose: Keep the actual racer and old results traceable.
Connect trackmaker inventory to valid race routes.
Preserve a competition without retroactive setup changes.
Make event participation and hosting meaningful economic actions.
Separate public attention from willingness, funding and completed sale.
Support hobby prestige without hidden-genotype exposure.

model_contract.drive: same Wave 03 force-speed form with shared power cap, drag and traction
model_contract.course: piecewise line/arc centerline, lateral offsets and offset-distance correction; connected closed loop
model_contract.movement: time-integrated longitudinal/lateral/height state; planned line changes; anticipatory turn braking
model_contract.jump: shared charged preload; return and phase reduce transferred energy; split useful energy into horizontal and vertical components; straight-tube/ceiling checks
model_contract.contact: path-space body envelopes; dissipative horn disruption; timed grasp/hold response
model_contract.classification: ordered section gates and interpolated finish times
limitations: Track section stock is declared per experiment; pooled track ownership and purchasing are not implemented
No full rigid-body or limb dynamics
Airborne motion follows a straight course tube; no free steering or branching flight
No graded damage, genetic horn morphology, full foot gait or ecology
No fully integrated race/world production clock
Path corner controller is not a physical spin/course-out solver
Experimental fixture mass, high-delivery reserve and NPC stock are disclosed in-kind inputs
Entry-order invariance and one timestep-halving comparison do not establish multiplayer fairness

meeting.scope: One funded demonstration and authored customer decision, not an autonomous economy.

trial_order.acceptance: ordinary measured assembly, no champion-gene guarantee

derived_project.requested_output: ordinary prepared assemblies; acceptance remains a bench test
derived_project.limits: A published race is not evidence of genotype or a guaranteed offspring result.

limitations: No repeat-cohort economy, mortality forecast, retention or purchase-conversion rate is claimed.
Race time is not yet integrated with the broader world scheduler.
Prize is paid once; replay scrubbing never produces a second transaction.

implementation_boundaries: Eight demand threads and six service contracts are specified; only result settlement and one authored funded inquiry execute.
W04.T01 is partly realized as a headless path-race model and replay, not closed as a finished game.
Repeated economy, staged reproduction and editable bench tasks remain in the existing queue.

findings.finding: Replay could show fitted stock, but the user could not place or change it.
findings.repair: An editable draft, atomic fitting and live race entry share the same component identities.

findings.finding: A fresh browser implementation risked becoming a second unrelated race formula.
findings.repair: Port the unchanged W04 operations and compare six reference experiments numerically.

findings.finding: Treating root position as decoration would disconnect the kit from racing.
findings.repair: Support and root overlap gate fitting; alignment, reach and yaw map to stated behavior. Inert positioning changes are not falsely credited as performance.

systems.title: Draft, fitted host and physical custody

rules.statement: A draft changes a proposed arrangement, not the host or current component custody.
rules.decision: Try a new build before committing.
rules.consequence: The currently fitted racer remains available and unchanged.

rules.statement: A fitting commit validates the whole draft, then swaps the intended components together.
rules.decision: Fit an accepted layout.
rules.consequence: A failure does not remove half a build or install a duplicate.

rules.statement: The same prepared sect identity may be loose, packaged or installed in the broader system, but never in two places at once.
rules.decision: Choose its present use.
rules.consequence: A saved recipe is not an additional component.

rules.statement: Repeated fitting of an unchanged arrangement is a no-op.
rules.decision: Confirm or retry safely.
rules.consequence: No second revision, duplicate anatomy or charge is created.

rules.statement: Replacement native units are explicitly retained in the W05 bench cradle.
rules.decision: Return an installed replacement.
rules.consequence: The retained native unit is reinstalled; tissue is not regenerated.

rules.statement: This reusable preparation profile applies only to the declared bench experiment.
rules.decision: Select the branch explicitly.
rules.consequence: W04 removal, injury and preservation decisions remain open elsewhere.

rules.statement: Returning a component in the draft does not yet make the fitted item loose.
rules.decision: Review removals before commitment.
rules.consequence: Draft and installed readouts use different labels.

rules.statement: A whole multi-role Hopper assembly contributes mass and inventory once.
rules.decision: Use the paired unit rather than duplicated role slots.
rules.consequence: Jump and landing capabilities do not create extra limbs.

rules.statement: A host retains its nameable identity across fitted versions.
rules.decision: Rebuild the same racer.
rules.consequence: A new configuration is not a newly bred animal.

rules.statement: Any future payment or care commitment must attach to the actual fitting transaction.
rules.decision: Extend the fixture into the operating world.
rules.consequence: Free session editing is not claimed as calibrated workshop economics.

systems.title: Meaningful placement and bounded physical fitting

rules.statement: Prepared-root ranges describe the supported geometry of the current components, not a universal species permission.
rules.decision: Move a root within its usable preparation.
rules.consequence: Unsupported fit identifies the component and needed correction.

rules.statement: Root collision is checked using oriented rectangles on named attachment layers.
rules.decision: Rotate or reposition a conflicting component.
rules.consequence: Intersecting same-layer roots block commitment; different layers can coexist.

rules.statement: The prepared starter host has one primary-drive interface in this fixture.
rules.decision: Choose Redline, Torque or retained native drive.
rules.consequence: The local interface limitation does not ban multi-drive roaches from RRR.

rules.statement: A central horn and split brow vanes can coexist if their actual roots do not intersect.
rules.decision: Compose rather than obey an arbitrary brow-slot ban.
rules.consequence: The accepted arrangement is visible and can enter Open.

rules.statement: Hopper rotation and off-center fitting contribute mounting error separately from inherited phase.
rules.decision: Align the prepared pair.
rules.consequence: Remounting can change useful launch transfer without rewriting ancestry.

rules.statement: Horn forward position and yaw change projected reach; lateral offset changes its modeled contact line.
rules.decision: Adjust the contact geometry.
rules.consequence: The displayed fit has a named mechanical consequence.

rules.statement: Claw placement changes modeled reach and angle can change closure delay.
rules.decision: Set the intended interception envelope.
rules.consequence: No passive armor or remote control effect is added.

rules.statement: Not every permitted cosmetic or spatial adjustment must improve lap time.
rules.decision: Fit for clearance, appearance or performance as appropriate.
rules.consequence: The UI does not manufacture a bonus for every drag.

systems.title: Inherited traits, setup and source function

rules.statement: Drive cadence and useful force remain separate from hip leverage.
rules.decision: Select a drive then tune its delivery.
rules.consequence: A gear-equivalent does not create a second motor.

rules.statement: Preload spends the available launch supply and is bounded by the local assembly profile.
rules.decision: Select an active-jump setup.
rules.consequence: A dormant or absent Hopper does not confer an unexplained speed multiplier.

rules.statement: Reserve fill changes starting energy and entry mass; storage capacity and delivery remain component properties.
rules.decision: Prepare a short run or a longer run.
rules.consequence: Feeding does not mutate inherited reserve quality.

rules.statement: Running stance changes the modeled body envelope and passing clearance.
rules.decision: Choose a wider or narrower configuration.
rules.consequence: Visual stance and collision width come from the same setting.

rules.statement: The current pad model changes traction; full peel-release gait is not claimed.
rules.decision: Compare the defined contact contribution.
rules.consequence: Untested foot dynamics remain explicit missing fidelity.

rules.statement: The split-vane fixture adds a speed-dependent hold-down term rather than powered flight.
rules.decision: Fit aero to a ground racer.
rules.consequence: It can affect traction and corner control without granting Flyer eligibility.

rules.statement: Livery, name and number have no mechanical multiplier.
rules.decision: Make the racer recognizable.
rules.consequence: Appearance and collection value do not require fabricated race superiority.

rules.statement: Available measurements in this stock profile are declared fixture observations.
rules.decision: Inspect the known stock.
rules.consequence: No full genotype oracle or unperformed assay is presented as earned knowledge.

systems.title: Actual entry, frozen records and comparisons

rules.statement: Race entry requires a committed design; an unresolved draft is neither silently discarded nor silently installed.
rules.decision: Commit or revert deliberately.
rules.consequence: The entered build is unambiguous.

rules.statement: A race is newly computed from its entry snapshot rather than chosen from a result table.
rules.decision: Test a new assembly or setting.
rules.consequence: Changed parts can cause changed motion and finish times.

rules.statement: Class checks inspect actual offensive capability, not the selected approach or product label.
rules.decision: Enter Speedsters, Fireworks or Open.
rules.consequence: A peaceful policy does not legalize a fitted weapon in Speedsters.

rules.statement: Current editable events are ground-only.
rules.decision: Use supported practice settings.
rules.consequence: Full sustained-flight simulation remains open rather than approximated by a ground race.

rules.statement: Rivals use independently identified declared stock and published fixture behavior.
rules.decision: Choose a useful practice opponent.
rules.consequence: The rival does not read hidden player genetics to manufacture a counterbuild.

rules.statement: Frozen results preserve the build, positions, appearance, settings, course and policy used at entry.
rules.decision: Watch, export or inspect an old run.
rules.consequence: Later bench edits do not alter a previous finish.

rules.statement: A matched comparison requires the same course, laps, class, rival and starting grid.
rules.decision: Pin a useful reference.
rules.consequence: A changed course is flagged rather than attributed solely to the component.

rules.statement: Practice, replay and exported result records do not mint prize money or advance the world clock in this slice.
rules.decision: Experiment without fictional payouts.
rules.consequence: The separate coupled-clock and funded-event tasks remain open.

rules.statement: An unfinished run reports no finish instead of a synthetic low score or fabricated time.
rules.decision: Inspect the loss or revise the build.
rules.consequence: First valid finish remains the racing objective.

systems.title: Personal recipes and commercial kit specifications

rules.statement: A personal build sheet references component instances and settings; it does not grant ownership.
rules.decision: Keep or share an arrangement.
rules.consequence: Import cannot create a donor, genome, wallet or trophy.

rules.statement: A commercial recipe references acceptable component families, measured ranges and preparation tolerances.
rules.decision: Produce coordinated kits from nonidentical individuals.
rules.consequence: Usable consistency does not require genetic clones.

rules.statement: Personal instance sheets and commercial product specifications remain distinct document types.
rules.decision: Reproduce a personal build or produce a repeatable product.
rules.consequence: The current exact-stock importer is not advertised as a general market solver.

rules.statement: A commercial bill of materials identifies retained native anatomy and all transferred components.
rules.decision: Package an honest kit.
rules.consequence: Several functional roles cannot conceal missing or duplicated tissue.

rules.statement: Substitution needs adequate function, physical fit and disclosed evidence.
rules.decision: Offer an alternative donor or preparation.
rules.consequence: A higher rarity label alone cannot certify an equivalent kit.

rules.statement: Build finishing can be commissioned independently of race tuning.
rules.decision: Pay for or provide an attractive finish.
rules.consequence: Aesthetic labor has a legitimate customer purpose without a stat aura.

rules.statement: A saved recipe may outlive the particular component it originally used.
rules.decision: Preserve a design after selling its stock.
rules.consequence: The later general importer must show missing parts, never restore ownership from history.

systems.title: Breeding stock and workbench expertise create different products

rules.statement: Breeders select for the traits a component or customer needs; fitters control preparation and arrangement.
rules.decision: Breed, buy, commission or personally build.
rules.consequence: A fitting improvement does not falsely certify improved inheritance.

rules.statement: A component can be strong but awkward to fit to a particular host.
rules.decision: Reserve it for a custom commission, adjust the preparation or choose another buyer.
rules.consequence: Poor fit for one kit is not universal low quality.

rules.statement: Production selection can include repeatable anatomical proportions where the donor genetics model supports them.
rules.decision: Raise the fraction of stock fitting an ordinary kit specification.
rules.consequence: The statistical/genetic model is an expansion task, not invented by this fixed catalogue.

rules.statement: A fitting commission names requested function, supplied stock, handling authority, labor, evidence, fee and acceptance.
rules.decision: Earn through building expertise.
rules.consequence: Compensation is attached to performed work rather than a promise of winning every race.

rules.statement: An inspection or bench trial can support a narrow claim about configuration.
rules.decision: Sell measurable adjustment work.
rules.consequence: One result does not imply an entire donor line is genetically certified.

rules.statement: Routine compatible stock, useful intermediates and unusual custom stock can serve different funded customers.
rules.decision: Allocate a cohort among production, selection, personal builds and sales.
rules.consequence: Progress does not wait for a perfect organism.

rules.statement: The editable prototype grants no new market funds, breeding output or service income.
rules.decision: Use it to establish the builder contribution.
rules.consequence: Economy behavior remains attached to the queued shared inventory and clock implementation.

systems.title: Creature-first interaction and accessible control

rules.statement: Tray parts display their own visual forms, identity and custody state.
rules.decision: Recognize a selected sect before opening numbers.
rules.consequence: Different donors are not anonymous stat cards.

rules.statement: Direct root dragging, arrow-key nudging and explicit fit controls act on the same draft.
rules.decision: Choose mouse, keyboard or tap-friendly controls.
rules.consequence: Precise pointer skill is not required to assemble the kit.

rules.statement: Anatomical illustration is generated from the actual placement and finish record.
rules.decision: Fit, move or recolor a part.
rules.consequence: The bench, saved sheet and recorded racer remain visibly connected.

rules.statement: Under-shell inspection reveals internal modules without equipping a different build.
rules.decision: Inspect the fitted drive or reserve.
rules.consequence: A view toggle does not change performance.

rules.statement: Expert controls expand inside a bounded desktop panel; mobile uses natural vertical flow.
rules.decision: Explore depth without losing the host or commit boundary.
rules.consequence: Optional controls do not generate a large empty canvas or hide the commit bar.

rules.statement: Bulk or gesture-level edits keep reversible draft history.
rules.decision: Undo an exploratory drag or a tuning gesture.
rules.consequence: Undo does not reverse a paid world transaction or alter a finished race.

rules.statement: During native tray dragging the dragged DOM node stays intact.
rules.decision: Drag a component into the prepared root area.
rules.consequence: Rendering cannot detach and cancel the source action.

rules.statement: Race order, action messages and a recorded-roach detail accompany the small track view.
rules.decision: Follow the race and recognize the fitted creature.
rules.consequence: Information is not available solely through tiny moving markers.

rules.statement: Reduced-motion preferences suppress automatic replay start.
rules.decision: Choose when to watch movement.
rules.consequence: The whole simulation remains available without forced autoplay.

rules.statement: Focus, labels, fit warnings and textual state supplement color.
rules.decision: Navigate and diagnose without relying on hue alone.
rules.consequence: A selected item and its inspector remain synchronized.

systems.title: Persistence, source parity and evidence boundaries

rules.statement: The browser port is compared with unchanged W04 Python sources before new profile extensions are credited.
rules.decision: Continue the same mechanical reference.
rules.consequence: Porting does not silently replace the underlying race model.

rules.statement: Local file storage may be unavailable; keep portable recipe export and reject invalid imported fields.
rules.decision: Retain work through an allowed path.
rules.consequence: No claim of universal browser persistence is made.

rules.statement: The model and worker fallback consume the same compiled entry payload.
rules.decision: Run without freezing the interface.
rules.consequence: A worker restriction does not select a canned result.

rules.statement: New fixture branches retain their input values and model versions.
rules.decision: Calibrate later without rewriting history.
rules.consequence: Body mass, root bounds and aero coefficients remain proposals.

rules.statement: Quality and novel-development adherence are non-compensable gates; unknown evidence remains open.
rules.decision: Assess the actual contribution at its scope.
rules.consequence: Test counts and documentation volume do not become an innovation grade.

rules.statement: The cumulative context appends W05 while preserving old records and waves.
rules.decision: Continue development without resetting the world.
rules.consequence: Earlier specimens, sources, decisions and historical demonstrations remain intact.

operational_threads.reward: Recognition, possible commissions or collector attention; no immediate money generated.
operational_threads.limit: Local exported records are not cryptographically authoritative competition results.

assets.name: Cicada Redline
assets.origin: Purchased from the Wave 3 brood margin
assets.purpose: Loaded cadence and useful force; compare at the same hip leverage.
assets.next: Cadence under load is the selection target. Loudness is not a test.

assets.name: Scarab Torque Bundle
assets.purpose: More driving force at lower cadence. A replaceable primary drive cassette in this bench profile.
assets.signature: Ivory muscle columns and dark seams
assets.next: Select force per muscle mass; grow-out supports the useful adult thorax.

assets.name: Grasshopper Hoppers
assets.origin: B1 brood / inherited F1 pair from Wave 3
assets.purpose: One paired assembly supplies running limbs, stored launch and landing recovery.
assets.signature: Folded amber femurs with joint bands
assets.next: Keep synchronized stock that complements a high-return line; this pair is useful F1 output, not a guaranteed champion.

assets.name: Nectar Crop
assets.purpose: High delivery feeds drive and active actions from the same reservoir.
assets.next: A full crop is temporary state. Reproductive colony stock supplies recurring donor workers.

assets.name: Sticktoe Contact Set
assets.purpose: Front and middle contact surfaces affect available traction in the simplified running model.
assets.next: Breed purchase and peel release separately. Full pad-release gait is not simulated by this multiplier.

assets.name: Bullhorn Ram
assets.purpose: An aligned charge can disrupt a rival. Forward placement changes the modeled reach.
assets.signature: Curved bone horn on a ribbed root
assets.next: Select root strength and useful curvature; the longest horn is not automatically the strongest.

assets.name: Mantis Catchclaws
assets.purpose: A timed counter-grasp can intercept a ram; it does not grant passive armor.
assets.next: Long reach matters when the arm still closes in time. Rearing requires protected individual compartments.

assets.name: Ashveil Split-Vanes
assets.source: Sheltered textile ruins / intact adult margins
assets.purpose: A small speed-dependent hold-down term increases contact load. This is stylized aero, not powered flight.
assets.next: Select stiff light surfaces. Split mounting can coexist with a central horn; there is no one-brow-slot ban.

Declared geometry and preparation of this component, not a species permission list.

rules.observable: A component entering the bench retains its actual donor identity.

rules.statement: Inherited potential is attached to the individual at creation.
rules.decision: Inspect, retain, breed, prepare or trade.

rules.statement: Whole-specimen records remain after sale, preparation or supported-body placement.

rules.statement: The shared-world custody function is authoritative; legacy bench-only custody is not a market ownership service.

operational_threads.purpose: A personally sourced component becomes visible race behavior through its exact donor and construction.
Useful intermediate generations can support a livelihood without being perfect racers.
Strategic production meets real downstream limits; upgrades are useful only for a genuine bottleneck.
Race attendance and a productive hobby operation coexist on the same clock.

model_contract.clock: in-world turns; offline pause; care charged each turn; replay free
model_contract.care: 1 workshop turn + ceil(live owned specimens/6) + number of active broods
model_contract.renewal: 12-turn quotas; up to 100 off-screen receipts refill shop toward 180; external account records source
