fields.Open: A course must specify where the racers start, where they must go and what counts as finishing. Those requirements do not justify a universal parts budget or a hidden ban on inventive anatomy.
fields.Speedsters: Ordinary biting, collision and body contact remain part of racing. Dedicated attacking anatomy is judged by what the fitted preparation can do, not the shop label or a promise to use it peacefully.
fields.Fireworks: Minimum attack refers to an available, functioning offensive construction. Light protection refers to its real protective capacity and coverage; a heavily armored frame cannot escape the rule simply by being named a brace.
fields.Hoppers and flyers: A ballistic jump spends a launch and returns to a landing. Sustained flight repeatedly supplies aerial propulsion or support. The exact border, including glide-assisted and mixed-locomotion builds, belongs in the event’s published capability definition, not an arbitrary insect-name list.
fields.No forced austerity: A newcomer may choose an affordable horn or hopper project in an appropriate event. Learning the hobby does not require an artificially weaponless opening culture.

entries.title: The road to New World City

fields.Established route: Locals → Regionals → Factionals → faction representation in New World City → the What’s Left of the World Derby.
fields.Local purpose: Build a recognizable competitive record among people who can see the roach and its construction. Some local events qualify competitors; ordinary club races can exist without doing so.
fields.Regional purpose: Meet a broader pool of constructors, sources and course traditions. More varied competition should expose real strengths and weaknesses, not apply an invisible regional multiplier to every opponent.
fields.Factional purpose: Select representatives through the faction’s explicitly defined sporting process. Institutions may fund travel, prepare entrants, lend stock or commission builds; representation is not a species-ownership monopoly.
fields.World purpose: The mature hobby converges on its most visible championship. The final’s prestige can sustain manufacturers, collectors, sponsors and publications without making World City the only place where the hobby matters.
fields.Unwritten details: Named factions, territories, selection quotas, championship calendar and travel requirements need dedicated entries. They are not quietly supplied by a prototype’s two unlocked event cards.

entries.title: A modular course has four separate identities

fields.Pattern: A repeatable section design has connectors, a traveled surface, boundary geometry and any necessary supports. Its visual scrap material does not replace those properties.
fields.Physical piece: A club or hobbyist owns a particular section. It can be maintained, repaired, painted, lent and returned. One physical piece cannot occupy two simultaneous layouts.
fields.Layout: An arrangement of pieces forms a route or set of routes. Connections, dimensions, elevation, passing space, mandatory gates and finish distance describe the construction.
fields.Event configuration: An event selects that layout version, permitted routes, lap requirements, equipment conditions and procedures. Later edits cannot change the course remembered by an old result.
fields.Historical plan: A drawing or saved plan preserves knowledge. Recreating it requires suitable actual sections and supports; owning its diagram is not owning the course.

entries.title: Course surfaces ask different things of the same body

fields.Smooth channel: A clear straight can reward pace and acceleration. Rail contact still depends on the line and neighbors; a guide gives no friction advantage while it touches nothing.
fields.Loose insert: Ash or fragmented material changes foot purchase and possible fouling. The same geometry can therefore support a different contact choice without an arbitrary region-wide stat penalty.
fields.Raised approach: A ventral brake engages only if actual geometry brings it into contact. A rise is one possible trigger; the universe is not limited to the final thirty percent of one prototype piece.
fields.Landing: Trajectory, available space, arrival posture, compliant travel, damping and return to useful contact all matter. Some constructions need a longer landing; others can carry a more controlled approach.
fields.Shared section: An open pack channel permits passing and contact. Solid lane walls still block physical interactions. Lane-guided and shared-space tracks can both belong to the hobby.
fields.Aerial section: A Flyer course needs a defined three-dimensional route and completion sequence. Ordered hoops are a valid construction vocabulary; simply lifting a ground ribbon off the floor does not supply aerial decisions.

entries.title: Procedures protect the race without replacing it

fields.Before entry: Publish the meaningful geometry, equipment policy, participation requirements, prize terms and consequences of retirement. Inspection assesses the actual construction.
fields.At the start: All entrants follow the same declared release procedure. A physical or timed event format must address starting-position advantages appropriately rather than assume symmetry.
fields.Between races: Any permitted rebuilding and inspection interval belongs to the format. A frozen completed heat never follows a later change in anatomy.
fields.After the finish: Present the winner, placing, close finishes, records and earned qualifications before optional diagnosis. No finish, a withdrawal and a legitimate loss are different outcomes.
fields.Care and consequence: Race damage can materially affect the animal or its components. The compendium must distinguish repairable impairment, retirement, preparation damage and permanent loss before an implementation selects their probabilities.
fields.Limits of imported rules: Tamiya supplies evidence that inspection and classification are meaningful parts of the hobby. Its brand-only or damage restrictions are not transplanted into RRR’s Open class.

sections.title: 11. Material and visual object briefs
sections.intro: These are construction and presentation requirements for artists and content authors. They specify what an object communicates and how it participates in the hobby, without prescribing an engine, UI framework or final asset resolution.

entries.title: Recognizable anatomy before a stat panel

fields.Host continuity: Keep the native head, thorax and abdomen recognizable enough to identify the named animal through rebuilding. A grafted racer should read as one incorporated organism, not a pile of unrelated item thumbnails.
fields.Foreign anatomy: Preserve the donor’s characteristic material or shape where it helps recognition: a horn’s curve, folded grasping arm, ribbed drive bundle, segmented reserve or pleated wing surface.
fields.Junctions: A root should look incorporated and supported. Prepared collars may remain visible as useful construction details; avoid dressing every part as a bolted metal appliance when the premise is biological assimilation.
fields.Material roles: Supporting shell is rigid where it carries load; flexible seams articulate; contact pads deform where they touch; membranes fold and tension; reserves appear filled or depleted through their own form. These distinctions carry information.
fields.Finish: Applied colors and markings coexist with natural variants and breeder signatures. They do not need an invented performance effect. Essential motion, vents, contact surfaces and ownership identifiers must remain readable.
fields.Scale: The working direction remains bench-built and hand-carried. Absolute dimensions await the scale chapter; final artists should not alternate casually between tiny insects and rideable monsters.

fields.Appearance and construction: A small replaceable card beside a specific enclosure, with a clear stock name, stage, source or line and an illustrated distinguishing feature. Different individuals can carry attached smaller marks.
fields.Information and function: Identifies what the customer is looking at, whether it is offered as a breeder, donor, display specimen or ordinary stock, and which measurements are known.
fields.Hobby use: A hand-amended condition note or a demonstrated property can materially change the purchase decision. A breeding animal and a harvested part need different cards.
fields.Misreading to prevent: The card cannot expose unknown genetics or make every specimen in the tank identically excellent. Rare, measured and suitable must remain different labels.

fields.Appearance and construction: A shallow, cleanable tray with shaped root supports, separate paired wells where required, a specimen tag and space for the actual fitting instructions.
fields.Information and function: Keeps delicate joints aligned and makes the assembled unit intelligible: which tissues are supplied together, where its root belongs and what native anatomy it replaces.
fields.Hobby use: A paired leg assembly occupies one coordinated support. A brake strip prepared from the same foot material appears in a different support and carries a different purpose.
fields.Misreading to prevent: The tray does not regenerate removed tissue or preserve every material indefinitely. Its support and medium must match the prepared object.

fields.Appearance and construction: An illustrated lid showing the promised construction; protected host compartment; labeled sect wells; finish sheet; physical separator between the living host and loose preparations.
fields.Information and function: Declares one real host, the actual preparations, native functions retained, and a build guide. A conversion tin prominently states that no host is included.
fields.Hobby use: The recipient opens a project, identifies the parts, places them and gives the resulting roach its own identity. A signature edition can reproduce a recognizable design without cloning the original winner.
fields.Misreading to prevent: A painted lid is not evidence that the contents satisfy the recipe. Packaging cannot stop living care, create duplicate components or install the build automatically.

fields.Appearance and construction: A clear host outline with separately drawn prepared assemblies, their roots, orientation, working clearance and retained native structures. Pair-matched pieces share a visible grouping.
fields.Information and function: Translates a complex construction into an understandable first build. Alternate preparations show their actual arrangement instead of silently occupying an identical generic slot.
fields.Hobby use: Expert annotations can document preload, reserve position, contact choice and allowed substitutions. A restored historic sheet can have collection value separate from current performance.
fields.Misreading to prevent: The sheet must distinguish fit instructions from donor quality. Following an angle cannot give an ordinary part a nonexistent inherited trait.

fields.Appearance and construction: An enclosure system with visible laying or egg surfaces, appropriate young-stage space, accessible cohort marks and clearly separate retained reproductive stock.
fields.Information and function: Communicates the species-specific production process. Roots, soil columns, climbing stems, flight space and pupation sleeves are purposeful fittings, not interchangeable decorations.
fields.Hobby use: The occupied chamber, current stage and intended retained adults can be understood at a glance. Detailed pedigree and measurements stay attached to that cohort rather than becoming a second disconnected inventory.
fields.Misreading to prevent: The illustration may show observed living young, not reveal unhatched survival outcomes. Extra glass does not create fertile founders or improve genes.

fields.Appearance and construction: Individual supports for legs, wings or whole animals; breathable or otherwise appropriate compartment details; useful source tags; tool storage that does not crush the catch.
fields.Information and function: Makes the intended collection strategy visible. A careful specimen case prioritizes useful anatomy; a bulk carrier prioritizes volume under its declared handling conditions.
fields.Hobby use: An insect’s identity and source tag continue from the field to intake. A preserved perch or sleeve can reveal why that capture method was chosen.
fields.Misreading to prevent: Capacity depends on actual occupants and the declared handling profile, not rarity colors. A case is not a universal life-stage freezer.

fields.Appearance and construction: A shaped racing channel or other declared route component, reliable connector ends, a distinct working surface, support points, an owner mark and visible repairs that do not obscure its geometry.
fields.Information and function: Makes modular ownership and different surface behavior legible. Clean enamel, loose inserts, raised approaches and abrasive rails should not all be indistinguishable scrap.
fields.Hobby use: It can travel in a section case, join a club pool, become part of a new layout and reappear in a historic recreation. Repair work can preserve utility and sentimental value.
fields.Misreading to prevent: A backdrop crossing is not automatically a connected overpass. Cosmetic rust does not secretly create an unannounced obstacle.

fields.Appearance and construction: A durable identity record with a recognizable host image, chosen name, owner or team mark, configuration references and detachable or replaceable race-result entries.
fields.Information and function: Separates the animal from its current construction and records meaningful achievements. A trophy refers to the entered configuration without permanently fixing the creature in that shape.
fields.Hobby use: It supports displays, restoration projects, public build features and provenance-led trade. Ownership changes can be recorded without erasing earlier results.
fields.Misreading to prevent: Paperwork does not grant missing animal ownership, expose a private genome or make an unverified seller claim true.

entries.title: Movement is part of an asset’s identity

fields.What should be recognizable: A working muscle tensions, a linked pair coordinates, a foot plants and peels, a horn loads its root, a grasping arm closes, a spring compresses, and a damper moves relative to the host.
fields.What must agree: The visible action corresponds to the fitted preparation and current circumstances. A host without Hoppers cannot display their launch; a brake above the surface cannot create a contact skid.
fields.No compulsory noise: Camera shake, motion blur, screen-wide flashes and constant decorative particles are not substitutes for readable anatomy. Race position and an important action must remain followable.
fields.Failure recognition: A late clasp, insufficient takeoff clearance, snagged contact or prolonged settling should look different. That difference gives the breeder or builder a useful next question.
fields.Unresolved art decisions: Final animation frame budgets, viewpoint, pixel scale and rendering style require their own art-direction record; the compendium specifies the information and character to preserve, not a guessed engine pipeline.

sections.title: 12. Integrated reference chains
sections.intro: Each chain identifies a desire, a biological target, a construction and a customer. These are reusable design cases, not scripted quests, mandatory recipes or guaranteed outcomes.

fields.Desire: The racer has useful drive but its current feet remain planted too long between steps. Alternatively, a maker needs contact sets for a quick-stepping kit.
fields.Reference function: The tire function is contact. Distinguish sufficient purchase from rapid release, and inspect both under the appropriate surface and load.
fields.Source and selection: Glazed Overgrowth supplies Glassfoot stock. Observe clean attachment and release; retain a quick-releasing animal as a complement to an already high-purchase line even if it is not the best immediate donor.
fields.Breeding and production: Rear the appropriate stages in a vertical arrangement. Record the useful inherited contributions separately from damage, recent humidity and preparation. Suitable offspring supply front/middle contact sets or alternatively brake material.
fields.Fitting and race or display: Fit real pads to the selected limb pairs. A faster release is visible in renewed stepping; it does not give another free drive organ or cancel unsupported turning loads.
fields.World and livelihood: Ordinary offspring can supply standard kits. A selected line can serve rapid-release component orders or breeding-stock requests. Collector markings remain separately desirable.

entries.title: The founding jumper, developed into a line

fields.Desire: The owner wants a fast, spectacular Hopper racer; the current high-return stock launches strongly but inconsistently.
fields.Reference function: The compound assembly contains propulsion-support geometry and landing roles; active jumping is RRR’s own extension of the build-and-race foundation.
fields.Source and selection: Switchyard Reclamation supplies paired hind limbs and unrelated founders. Seek close release timing and intact joints; the single farthest observed escape leap is not a complete measurement.
fields.Breeding and production: Cross for the missing contribution, retain useful partial outcomes and preserve reproductive adults. Decide whether a particular offspring should provide a full Hopper, a joint preparation or future breeding stock.
fields.Fitting and race or display: Preload, alignment, approach and landing support remain builder choices. A favorable line creates better possibilities; the creature still needs a physical launch and landing.
fields.World and livelihood: The same lineage can supply personal upgrades, ordinary Hopper tins, selected pairs and appearance-led editions. A famous victory advertises one recorded build, not guaranteed victories for its descendants.

entries.title: A course generates two different material requests

fields.Desire: A club introduces a short raised approach and an abrasive outside rail. Some racers arrive too fast; others lose work while riding the wall.
fields.Reference function: Contact braking removes approach motion. A guide changes supported rail contact. They are not interchangeable stability items.
fields.Source and selection: Dry Feltworks supplies resilient ventral material; Underpipe Aprons supplies low-loss supporting shell. Preserve the specific surface or paired shell regions, not merely the whole animal’s cosmetic condition.
fields.Breeding and production: Material breeders pursue an appropriate friction/retention/travel combination for the pad, or low sliding loss plus support for the guide. One target is not inferred from the other.
fields.Fitting and race or display: The fitter sets clearance and guide position. The brake must touch, the guide must touch its rail, and neither works everywhere because it belongs to a purchased set.
fields.World and livelihood: A trackmaker earns for construction; breeders and fitters supply the resulting material needs; the club can borrow sections and publish the changed layout. A new track does not automatically force every entrant to buy the same equipment.

entries.title: Useful force without confusing support and armor

fields.Desire: An Open builder wants a horn-driven racer capable of accelerating with substantial mounted anatomy.
fields.Reference function: Muscle output, delivery geometry, supporting frame and protective shell have different functions.
fields.Source and selection: Cooling Works offers scarab stock, Bullhorn sources and nearby useful power donors. Select force under load, good structural support per mass and a horn root suited to its contact geometry.
fields.Breeding and production: A scarab line can specialize in drive or supporting plates. Disjoint harvested regions may supply several products; the resulting donor state and vitality consequences remain explicit.
fields.Fitting and race or display: The construction aligns charge forces through adequate support. A different gear ratio can help the intended approach while lowering free running speed. Adding armor is an additional decision, not a free property of a broad frame.
fields.World and livelihood: Loaded Open kits, light Fireworks derivatives and standalone structural stock have different customers. A protective shell may make a build illegal in one division while being desirable in another.

entries.title: A Flyer industry needs more than wings

fields.Desire: A lanista wants to enter the aerial sport; a supplier wants to produce complete flight assemblies rather than fragile display surfaces.
fields.Reference function: Body, output, leverage, reserve and control remain recognizable construction roles, but powered flight requires a genuinely different movement system.
fields.Source and selection: Cooling-pond margins can supply the proposed Glasswing line. Intact adult surfaces and supported wing roots matter to immediate components; viable reproductive stock and the aquatic stages matter to continuing production.
fields.Breeding and production: The producer supplies aquatic rearing, emergence, space to expand wings, adult care and appropriate reproduction. A tank that merely keeps adults on display does not complete the cycle.
fields.Fitting and race or display: The host needs supported roots, flight drive, wing-root transmission, adequate delivery and information usable by actual correction movements. Aerial paths and gates define the race; a browfoil is not a flight kit.
fields.World and livelihood: Suppliers can sell adult wing/root assemblies, breeding stock, emergence services, complete Skyhook projects and replacement components. The compendium defines this industry even before an engine implements flight.

entries.title: A collection piece with an honest history

fields.Desire: A collector wants a historic style or a distinctive natural form, not necessarily the fastest currently available build.
fields.Reference function: Body choice, color, decals and the physical hobby’s product editions supply an appearance and collecting reference. RRR adds living lineages and graft provenance.
fields.Source and selection: A distinctive shell marking, carefully selected Ashveil form or preserved host lineage may supply the desired identity. Its racing measurements remain independent.
fields.Breeding and production: Breed supported appearance traits only through a declared heredity profile; record the difference between an original specimen, a descendant, a restored object and a new replica.
fields.Fitting and race or display: A finisher composes natural coloration, graft junctions, marks and silhouette while preserving working surfaces. A replica follows a recognizable construction without claiming to be the original animal.
fields.World and livelihood: A collector, restorer, finisher, publisher or maker can each supply a useful part of the project. A provenance premium requires a buyer who values the supported history; the history is not a performance multiplier.

sections.title: 13. Editorial amendments and remaining design commitments
sections.intro: The amendments below change how earlier material should be interpreted in the compendium. They do not rewrite historical test inputs, erase useful experiments, or claim that downstream software already implements the new qualitative definitions.

entries.title: Prototype scope is not the size of the world

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Six specimens in a patch, a fixed board size, paired heats and three quantitative loci were used by bounded experiments.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: World variety, species reproductive models, race formats and habitat populations are authored independently of those technical bounds. Preserve the older values as named experimental profiles only.
fields.Purpose: Prevents subsequent authors from mistaking a small demonstration for a universal biological or sporting limit.

entries.title: The host and the frame are different objects

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Early car-to-roach mappings could make body selection, chassis-like native form and frame preparation overlap.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: The host is the persistent animal; its body plan supplies native geometry. A frame preparation alters load-bearing support. Protective carapace is a third function.
fields.Purpose: Gives three legitimate construction and breeding decisions without charging the same anatomy three times.

entries.title: Synchronization is not a variable gear ratio

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Hip leverage and paired timing appeared under a shared gear-equivalent category.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Keep their functions separate. Lowstep and Longthrow change force/travel delivery; Lockstep coordinates timing. A combined assembly can contain both, but timing does not create force or change ratio by name.
fields.Purpose: Allows purposeful donor selection and a correct construction explanation before any equation is chosen.

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Sensing, physical bracing, wall contact and sliding guidance all help some aspect of handling.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Gyropods detect and communicate; Counterbraces make support contacts; Guardknuckles catch a lean; Railshoes carry sliding contact. Each needs its own circumstance and actual physical effect.
fields.Purpose: Prevents generic stability stacking and gives four different reasons to seek stock.

entries.title: Contact material is not one grip number

fields.Earlier ambiguity: An adhesive surface can be described as universally better because it holds harder.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Distinguish purchase, release, area, orientation, load, contamination and friction against the named surface. The same tissue can serve running feet or a brake through different preparation.
fields.Purpose: Preserves the purpose of contact compounds while making the insect translation mechanically distinct.

entries.title: Incoming impact, rebound and recovery are separate

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Landing joints, added tissue mass and balance response risk being treated as interchangeable time reductions.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Compliance accommodates impact; a properly configured damper dissipates relative motion; sensing and actuators restore useful posture. None can silently substitute for the missing anatomy of another.
fields.Purpose: Connects visible action, selective traits and component preparation instead of awarding an unexplained handling buff.

entries.title: Prepared exchange does not own assimilation

fields.Earlier ambiguity: The historical collar fixture supports safe reversible demonstrations but could be read as a universal required proprietary socket.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Assimilation remains innate and broadly compatible. Prepared exchange boundaries support repeatable hobby rebuilding. Raw incorporation, vital extraction, damage and material preservation retain their own consequences.
fields.Purpose: Preserves both the founding slap-on invention and the mature kit industry without making either nonsensical.

entries.title: Named products do not define a hidden taxonomy

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Historical trade names such as Locust Springknees can appear beside a Switchyard Hopper source and imply a new unrecorded species.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Record donor form and preparation pattern separately. Keep a useful established product name, but identify the actual anatomy supplying it. A future locust donor requires its own monograph.
fields.Purpose: Avoids accidental extra species, duplicated tissue and conflicting source routes.

entries.title: Availability, improvement and collector value remain independent

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Grade labels, rare finds, prototype thresholds and larger geometry could be mistaken for one universal progression ladder.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Use named component-purpose measurements for performance, explicit supply history for availability, and supported appearance/provenance for collection. Genuine multi-property upgrades remain possible; operating alternatives need not be ranked universally.
fields.Purpose: Protects both satisfying upgrades and nuanced construction choices.

entries.title: Qualitative birth-to-part continuity precedes a complete simulation

fields.Earlier ambiguity: A useful juvenile stage, growing donor and harvested sect can be conflated into one changing record.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: The living donor progresses through its declared stages. Prepared anatomy then has its own identity and condition. Retained adult breeders, juvenile components and post-harvest material cannot be substituted silently.
fields.Purpose: Makes life-stage collecting, production and storage understandable without imposing a universal timer.

entries.title: Unimplemented is not absent from the universe

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Flight, broader morphology and later championships repeatedly appeared only as runtime prerequisites.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Author their required anatomy, course, institutions and consequences in the compendium when useful. Mark their definitions as proposals and their software status separately. Do not wait for executable flight before defining the Flyer hobby.
fields.Purpose: Keeps universe creation ahead of implementation without claiming that a described feature is playable.

entries.title: Old observations survive an editorial interpretation change

fields.Earlier ambiguity: Previous waves contain working anatomy and example coefficients beside implementation evidence.
fields.Current compendium interpretation: Preserve old source files and records. Add named interpretation amendments and new reference entries. No saved genome, trial result, owner or paid transaction is recalculated by this compendium wave.
fields.Purpose: Enables a coherent current reading without falsifying the project’s history.

entries.title: Decisions that need their own authored chapter

fields.Biosphere and history: The survival of humans and other donor insects alongside the roaches’ exceptional nuclear-winter survival needs a consistent account. Sealed vaults, refuges or later recovery must not become canon merely because an early assistant proposed them.
fields.Scale: Choose a stable physical scale for hosts, sources, handling, housing and circuits. Relative working roles are defined here; exact dimensions are not invented.
fields.Loss and renewal: Determine the experience of damage, ordinary recovery, aging, irreversible injury, donor reproduction and rare material renewal. Preserve meaningful consequences without silently imposing either universal invulnerability or mandatory loss of beloved racers.
fields.Heredity: Expand each donor’s actual reproductive and variation model, including whether the proposed morphology families can appear, how they are inherited and what observations support a selection decision.
fields.Wider sport: Name faction institutions, define their representation process, establish championship geography, and provide full aerial-course and sport-specific action references.
fields.Care and commerce: Finish the product-specific handling, storage, exchange, shipping and restoration monographs. Price, elapsed time and probability calibration follow those meaningful distinctions rather than replace them.

question_index.question: What does a drive change, and what must gearing still do?
Why keep an insect that is weaker than the current racer?
What must a usable graft connect to on the host?
How are sensing, braces, guides and suspension different?
What does an actual Hopper action contain?
What can a Wrangloid sell and what knowledge earns their living?
What should an artist put in a living kit or shop?
What makes an upgrade, a variant and a collectible different?
How do routine swaps preserve the original mutation premise?
Which limits belong to earlier demos rather than the universe?
How should a course, race class and qualification be defined?
What are the requirements for the Flyer hobby?

hard_conditions: Required quality at declared reference-authoring scope
MIVIM.comparator: A renamed equipment list or a prototype changelog in which the next developer must invent the biology, purpose and world relationships.
MIVIM.delivered_difference: Thirty anatomy-and-purpose monographs, distinct action definitions, production and exchange practices, morphology proposals, coherent sets, institutions, object briefs and linked use cases.
MIVIM.effectiveness: Reference questions are answerable through named entries and explicit distinctions. No downstream developer study has yet measured reduced ambiguity or better game results.
MIVIM.creativity: Concrete project-specific anatomical and hobby integration has been authored. Worldwide originality and player-perceived novelty are not established.
MIVIM.scaling_potential: Reusable object fields and cross-references support further donors, sets and regions without inventing a separate system for each. Large-team authoring performance is not measured.
MIVIM.quality: Editorially reviewed at compendium scope. Open biological, geographical and sporting decisions are listed rather than silently filled. No finished-game or human-usability acceptance is claimed.
MIVIM.no_numeric_grade: There is no authorized numerical MIVIM formula or fabricated weighted score.
MIVIM.supporting_checks: Serialization, internal references and baseline preservation only; not evidence of gameplay fun, physiology, economic balance or retention.

manifest.title: RRR — The Joined Hobby: Milestone Review and Progression Polish
manifest.serialization: Strict JSON in .spec, continuing the RRR exchange format; not an asserted canonical private MIVIM grammar.
manifest.authority: Author premises govern. These are working qualitative design amendments, not new runtime behavior, human study results or calibrated economic laws.

sources.title: SEGA — Gaiden Pocket Circuit customization image
sources.observed: The inspected image contains the eight performance-part headings, appearance controls, a body entry and aggregate build readings.
sources.design_use: Preserve distinct component functions and a recognizable whole build.
sources.limit: One image is not the complete PCR item database and supplies no isolated item formulas.

sources.title: SEGA — Gaiden Adventure, Pocket Circuit section
sources.observed: CourStar connects body/part acquisition, fastest-time play and local Rival challenges.
sources.design_use: Keep ordinary return visits, parts, recognizable rivals and racing closely connected.
sources.limit: The Coliseum material on the same page is not Pocket Circuit evidence.

sources.title: Tamiya — Mini 4WD Setup Guide
sources.observed: Motor categories, gear ratios, contact, brakes, dampers and layout choices have distinct setup purposes.
sources.design_use: Use mechanism-specific improvement paths, useful remounting, and several routes to a better racer.
sources.limit: Physical Mini 4WD is not Gaiden; fixed-wheel turning and published hobby dimensions are not RRR biology.
sources.read_scope: Guide text; no assertion that linked videos were watched.

sources.title: Tamiya — FM-A Balanced Starter Pack, item 18710
sources.observed: The assembly kit includes selected upgrade components, simple assembly features and access supporting setup changes.
sources.design_use: A complete first tin should be attainable, personally assembled and easy to revisit.
sources.limit: The source does not prescribe RRR prices, inherited traits or beginner win rates.

sources.title: Ryan, Rigby & Przybylski (2006) — The Motivational Pull of Video Games
sources.observed: Across the reported studies, perceived competence and autonomy were associated with enjoyment; a multiplayer-community study also examined relatedness and future play.
sources.design_use: Evaluate ownership of decisions, understandable improvement and meaningful social recognition separately.
sources.limit: Associations in those studies do not prove that these RRR revisions improve retention; NPC recognition is a design hypothesis, not the same evidence as human multiplayer relatedness.
sources.read_scope: Publisher abstract and bibliographic information; no full-method replication.

sources.title: Norton, Mochon & Ariely (2012) — The IKEA effect: When labor leads to love
sources.observed: The reported studies found greater valuation of successfully self-assembled objects; incomplete or subsequently destroyed projects did not retain the same effect.
sources.design_use: Protect reachable build completion, personal finishing and the continued existence of the reference racer.
sources.limit: Physical consumer-object tasks are not a direct test of digital kit racing. More work is not automatically better work.

sources.title: Andersen et al. (CHI 2012) — The Impact of Tutorials on Games of Varying Complexity
sources.observed: Eight tutorial designs across three games produced effects that depended on complexity; the simpler games did not show the same significant engagement benefit as the complex game.
sources.design_use: Expose help where a decision needs it; preserve experimentation and advanced depth without an obligatory complete lecture.
sources.limit: Results from those games supply a question to test, not a universal tutorial length or expected percentage gain.
sources.read_scope: Authors’ project abstract and resource listing.

sources.title: Mewgenics — developer-authored description
sources.observed: Expeditions return resources and animals; breeding carries traits into later generations; house investment and keeping particular animals create competing decisions.
sources.design_use: Keep immediate usable output, retained founders and facility investment connected across activities.
sources.limit: Do not copy undocumented inheritance probabilities, mutation rates, mandatory losses, or claim breeding alone caused commercial success.
sources.read_scope: About This Game section; marketing scope is not independent engagement evidence.

sources.title: Wube — Friday Facts #375: Quality
sources.observed: The 2023 design account distinguishes horizontal expansion from vertical improvement and describes higher-quality production as optional with useful intermediate outputs.
sources.design_use: Give RRR both productive specialization and more capacity; lower-tier output needs deliberate uses while ambitious improvement remains optional.
sources.limit: A historical design account, not a claim about every current coefficient. No quality-module lottery, forced recycling, universal stat bonus or technology-gated genes are imported.

sources.title: Tamiya — Independent organizer resources
sources.observed: Circuit loans, setup guidance, layout resources and event publicity support organizers.
sources.design_use: Make clubs, shared bench access, course crews and recurring informal participation credible.
sources.limit: Does not establish RRR sponsor budgets, labor rates or qualification formulas.

sources.title: Tamiya — Official Mini 4WD Race Regulations
sources.observed: Inspection, starts, completion and classification are explicit sporting functions.
sources.design_use: Advertise event conditions, retain a real finish, and separate re-inspection from changing an active heat.
sources.limit: Do not import brand-only, damage, equipment or dimensional restrictions into RRR Open.
sources.read_scope: Rules text; no claim that RRR mirrors the entire regulation.

sources.title: Tamiya — Product classification definitions
sources.observed: Continuing, revived, intermittent and limited products are different availability categories.
sources.design_use: Separate everyday useful stock from historical editions and collection scarcity.
sources.limit: Availability is not a performance or genetic-rarity scale; no expiration pressure is imported.

sources.title: Anthony Giovannetti / Mega Crit — Slay the Spire: Metrics Driven Design and Balance (GDC 2019)
sources.observed: The session overview describes use of metrics and community feedback while maintaining game feel and difficulty.
sources.design_use: Specify comparisons of choices, understanding, cost and experience rather than celebrating only output counts.
sources.limit: Only the session description was inspected; no unviewed talk details, balancing formula or Slay the Spire mechanism is attributed.
sources.read_scope: Official GDC session abstract, not the full recording.

Reference.review_scope: Three overlapping historical periods: 0–5, 5–10, 10–15. Boundary waves 5 and 10 are reviewed at both joins, not counted as extra releases. Wave 15 includes this milestone itself.
Reference.history_note: Wave 00 denotes the author brief, not an invented release file. Original Wave10 runtime is unavailable; its written handoff is reviewed and W12 remains its declared reconstruction.

phase_review.title: The racer and the kit
phase_review.retained: Distinct source-component functions, personally assembled hosts, reversible drafts, actual anatomy, recognizable builds, and race outcomes.
phase_review.weak_join: The initial complete-kit pleasure can disappear beneath the later requirement to operate collection, certification and production before the next improvement.
phase_review.developed: Preserve a complete first-project path, bounded ordinary bench sessions, visible cause-and-effect comparisons, and functional intermediate conversions.

phase_review.title: The living source and productive workshop
phase_review.retained: Purposeful donors, stage-aware facilities, complementary breeding, unique preparation, stable ownership, parts trade and owned courses.
phase_review.weak_join: Separate valid costs, reservations and waiting can accumulate into mandatory administration; protected descendants and unsold output can grow faster than useful demand.
phase_review.developed: Contextual field evidence, split-brood milestones, target-based replacement reserves, maintenance plans, explicit ordinary outlets and useful progress within qualification bands.

phase_review.title: Public competition, products and the world reference
phase_review.retained: Evidence-backed living supply, intact reference racers, alternate-stock kits, actual recipients, component-built rivals, fieldcraft, and current compendium anatomy.
phase_review.weak_join: Finite sponsored examples, disconnected customer futures, a negative first maker margin and accumulated prototype constraints can be mistaken for the mature hobby’s intended rules.
phase_review.developed: Separate maker livelihoods, purpose-funded repeat work, persistent ordinary sport, collection/display completion, clean stopping and explicit authority amendments.

files: Author concept and corrections in conversation
wave_review.retain: Race victories, personally assembled kits, whole-insect sourcing and broad participation.
wave_review.critical_finding: The earliest framing denied wanting the fastest racer and substituted solving a track for winning.
wave_review.revision: No later system may require a novice to become a breeder or accountant before racing; personalization, actual speed and victory remain direct rewards.
wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.revision: Use source families as a functional audit, not a global equipment grid; attach institutions to practical return visits.
wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.retain: Traits, donor habitats, alternate anatomy, production and market purposes.
wave_review.critical_finding: Many admirable local decisions create a long mandatory chain if all are required for the first useful part.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.revision: Keep reservations backstage while authored project milestones describe useful descendants and the next voluntary decision.
wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.revision: Require representative course/traffic opportunities and visible recognition before claiming a construction family delivers its advertised fantasy.
wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.retain: Eight core families with actual mechanisms, donor-specific rearing and a two-way shop.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

wave_review.evidence_scope: Reference/document review; no new runtime or human test.

findings.title: Serial dependency hides the fun
findings.retain: All activities share useful physical stock.
findings.diagnosis: Requiring collection, assay, breeding, certification and a sale before a first satisfying race defeats the kit entry path.
findings.acceptance: A shop-kit racer completes a personally fitted run without taking a breeding or field detour; those detours remain attractive.

findings.title: Ordinary iteration pays too many tolls
findings.retain: Real services, material consequences and shared time.
findings.diagnosis: Every small adjustment can individually trigger care, time and charges, making learning costly before decisions become consequential.
findings.acceptance: Repositioning ready owned exchange parts within a booked bench session does not repeat the whole visit charge; genuine new work is still paid.

findings.title: Mechanically active is not noticeably useful
findings.retain: No fake jumps or arbitrary performance auras.
findings.diagnosis: Small numerical effects or rare action triggers can leave a central sect fantasy present only in the catalogue.
findings.acceptance: Every promoted construction has a representative case with a visible useful effect and a counterexample explaining its limits.

findings.title: Useful information becomes a toll gate
findings.diagnosis: Hiding every relevant property until paid assay removes informed field selection and turns curiosity into an information toll.
findings.acceptance: Body, stage, damage and contextual action are observable; precision and hereditary certainty remain distinct paid or earned knowledge.

findings.title: Stacked uncertainty can erase the whole outing
findings.retain: Exceptional finds and failed projects can remain consequential.
findings.diagnosis: Encounter, visibility, capture, damage, viability, reproductive role, heredity, acceptance and buyers can compound into no usable outcome.
findings.acceptance: Trace the whole chosen route before assigning rarity or failure rates; provide agency at separate stages and alternative actual uses, not guaranteed rare loot.

findings.title: Brood retention becomes unbounded accumulation
findings.retain: Retain replacement parents and care for real stock.
findings.diagnosis: Automatically protecting another pair each brood can expand obligations without a deliberate growth decision.
findings.acceptance: A retention policy targets a maintained reserve, proposes replacements and never silently sells old favorites or grows its target.

findings.title: Intermediate successes still lack immediate use
findings.retain: Complementary inherited traits and honest evidence.
findings.diagnosis: Perfect-line pursuit becomes repeated rejection when useful current output has no designed audience or personal use.
findings.acceptance: A declared project identifies useful current components, complementary parents and actual ordinary customers before specifying its rare final target.

findings.title: Five labels do not constitute five reachable steps
findings.retain: Real improvements and family-specific all-criteria qualification.
findings.diagnosis: A coarse inherited distribution can skip most labels; improved axes can remain invisible when the headline band stays the same.
findings.acceptance: Separate measured delta, operating profile, morphology and certification; test reachable intermediate improvements without manufacturing empty tiers.

findings.title: A technically valid maker route loses money
findings.retain: Actual costs, owned inputs and legitimate payments.
findings.diagnosis: The recorded -38-credit manufacturing change cannot be marketed as sustainable income; higher sale receipts alone may hide duplicated cost or founder spend.
findings.acceptance: Matched prospective route budgets separate recurring margin, cash runway and research cost; negative repeat margin requires a changed business, not revised labels.

findings.title: One buyer bottleneck can disable every livelihood
findings.diagnosis: One experimental wallet and quota can make ordinary collectors, makers and selected breeders compete against the same unexplained shortage.
findings.acceptance: Buyer purposes, budgets and replenishment causes are distinct even when represented at one counter.

findings.title: Retail quotation repairs can hide the wrong incentive
findings.retain: No duplicated transactions or self-funded circular gains.
findings.diagnosis: Moving all retail quotes just above current orders treats an exploit symptom as economic identity and obscures why a product has value.
findings.acceptance: Price separates materials, performed service, holding and buyer purpose; legitimate time/place/service arbitrage remains possible.

findings.title: The sold product stops participating in the hobby
findings.retain: Real post-sale custody and owner-permitted construction information.
findings.diagnosis: A sold-kit table and a scripted inquiry do not yet express the satisfaction of seeing one’s work used.
findings.acceptance: A named recipient can use, display, request repair of, or commission a revision of that same product; money follows a new real transaction.

findings.title: Finite events can become the end of racing
findings.retain: Funded finite prize pools and valid qualification.
findings.diagnosis: Exhausting three scripted editions must not exhaust a world-popular hobby.
findings.acceptance: Local practice/rival play remains; renewed sponsored events have explicit funding and available participants; no replay pays.

findings.title: A two-racer solver has become a sporting template
findings.retain: Fair disclosed starts, valid finishes and actual opponents.
findings.diagnosis: Twelve mirrored heats are an experiment, not a required novice session or universal form of pack racing.
findings.acceptance: Event monographs state actual interaction and duration intent; no four-way claim for sequential pairs and no mandatory waiting through redundant full replays.

findings.title: Quick collecting and fieldcraft split the world
findings.retain: Both depth choices and stable individuals.
findings.diagnosis: Separate unnamed population inventories can duplicate stock or give one interface inherent genetic superiority.
findings.acceptance: Both modes name source and cohort, or explicitly distinct sites; method affects detection/preservation/cost rather than rewriting the catch.

findings.title: A larger stable brings overhead before a new pleasure
findings.retain: Living care and distinct persistent hosts.
findings.diagnosis: More racers can become liabilities if only one use, one season and one storage mode are designed.
findings.acceptance: Additional racers support alternative builds, exhibition, breeding or loan choices, with explicit maintenance service instead of compulsory active production.

findings.title: Collection is defended but not completed as a loop
findings.retain: Appearance may be desirable without a stat reward.
findings.diagnosis: Saying beauty matters is insufficient without acquisition purpose, display, recognition, preservation and a voluntary next project.
findings.acceptance: A display project has its own concrete object, recognizable result, real audience and optional next activity without genetic or price auras.

findings.title: Stopping feels like abandoning responsibilities
findings.retain: Offline pause and continued in-world care.
findings.diagnosis: A busy return can conceal unstarted plans, protected stock, pending bills and the last enjoyable goal.
findings.acceptance: A leave/return record preserves actual commitments and the selected next action; it requires no daily rescue or manufactured loss.

findings.title: Prototype successes and failures silently become law
findings.retain: Historical experiments and their exact limits.
findings.diagnosis: Equations, finite stock and tested branches have accumulated beside universe definitions without a single milestone conflict map.
findings.acceptance: Every W15 amendment names the old interpretation, replacement scope and remaining empirical question; old records are retained unchanged.

Reference.current_author_directive: Research and critically polish the accumulated game loops; connect all three periods without continuing prototype implementation or replacing the existing document/.spec format.

next_authoring.title: Donor monographs with life-stage, population and inheritance profiles
next_authoring.outcome: For prioritized ground and flight donors, author natural history as fiction, population differences, useful stage, inherited/developmental/condition distinctions, normal and exceptional variation, reproductive constraints and actual product/customer alternatives.
next_authoring.acceptance: Every trait can be found, observed to an appropriate degree, selected, bred or acquired through another legitimate route, and used in a named construction. Do not repeat the three-binary-locus template as universal biology.

next_authoring.title: Material, exchange and care monographs
next_authoring.outcome: Specify common reversible preparations, raw graft consequences, active tissue versus structural material, transport/holding requirements and named exceptions.
next_authoring.acceptance: A casual kit’s ready/working/stored states are understandable; difficult materials create purpose without a universal per-swap injury lottery or infinite preservation. Broad aging/death remains an explicit author decision.

next_authoring.title: Economy reference sheets for three distinct maker livelihoods
next_authoring.outcome: Author actual line-item design budgets and representative funded customer purposes for fitting, repeat kit production and breeder supply, with ordinary stock outlets and risk scenarios.
next_authoring.acceptance: Retain W12’s loss as history; show achievable positive and negative repeat margins under declared inputs rather than prescribe arbitrary price buffs. Separate endowed starting assets from new capital.

next_authoring.title: Construction opportunity and course atlas
next_authoring.outcome: Define ground and aerial course archetypes, legitimate alternative responses, ordinary club formats, supported material sources and the same anatomy’s visible actions.
next_authoring.acceptance: Every advertised signature construction has an enabling case, nonenabling case and useful alternative. Factional and Flyer worlds are authored as requirements, not closed through a renamed ground demo.

next_authoring.title: Heritage, appearance and recognizable product histories
next_authoring.outcome: Develop a bounded set of actual line/edition/display histories and distinct inheritance proposals for desired forms, plus buyer purposes and material-object briefs.
next_authoring.acceptance: A natural variant, applied finish, historic original, descendant and reproduction remain distinct; a completed collection goal does not require a performance justification.

next_authoring.title: Execute the six milestone comparison studies when playable systems are ready
next_authoring.outcome: Evidence about comprehension, chosen goals, visible mechanical value, affordable repetition and voluntary return.
next_authoring.acceptance: Do not equate minutes played, clicks, positive gross income, schema validity or prototype test counts with quality or demonstrated engagement.

Diagnose cross-system friction and preserve successful work

not_performed: No new application or game-logic implementation
No rerun of earlier gameplay experiments

hard_guardrails: Speed and race victory remain direct pleasures
Anyone can buy, catch and breed; no mandatory profession or gene-rank gate
Whole insects retain source, reproductive, commercial and collection value
Actual anatomy and ownership are never duplicated by a recipe or role label
Open equipment freedom and the author’s division distinctions remain
No hidden source-game formula is invented
Prototype limits are not promoted into universe law
Routine interaction does not become compulsion by real-world absence penalties
Adherence.uncertainty_policy: Distinguish observed source facts, prior authored evidence, analytical risks, new working definitions and untested experiential hypotheses.

systems.title: The first complete project and its optional branches
systems.problem: A coherent universe can still require too many preliminary occupations before the player experiences owning and racing a personally built roach.
systems.design_intent: Deliver a complete first project, then let its actual result create optional reasons to collect, breed, buy, earn or show.

rules.statement: An entry tin includes a functioning host, identified preparations, readable placement guidance, ordinary initial care supplies and a clearly advertised first-use opportunity. Omitted functions remain native.
rules.purpose: A novice can understand what they bought and finish assembling it without discovering an unadvertised required purchase.

rules.statement: The first assembly contains meaningful ownership decisions: choose a visible configuration, fit at least one relevant preparation, and give the racer its chosen appearance or identity. Repeating a saved familiar assembly may later be streamlined.
rules.purpose: Preserve building rather than replacing it with either an instant reward or repeated fastening chores.

rules.statement: A local first-use route permits a real race or time trial without breeding, exact genetic assays, commercial certification, named lineage or a prior victory. A first victory is not guaranteed.
rules.purpose: The participation floor is understandable; competitive success remains earned.

rules.statement: Entry products include accessible horn, grasping, hopper and clean-running constructions where the event permits them. Beginner support is not a mandatory weaponless chapter.
rules.purpose: The original derby identity is visible early rather than postponed until the end of the game.

rules.statement: After a completed activity, present the result and preserve the physical project before suggesting one chosen next objective. Options may include another race, one rebuild, a donor search, breeding or display.
rules.purpose: A finished racer is a reward in itself, not just an instruction to buy the next part.

rules.statement: Help appears at the relevant decision. An expert can expose anatomy, protocols and ancestry without repeating introductory instruction; a beginner need not read the whole reference to proceed.
rules.purpose: Guidance supports actual complexity without turning world breadth into an entrance examination.

rules.statement: Affordability of the entry package is evaluated against an explicitly authored ordinary earning opportunity and initial resources. Do not fund it by selling protected founders or dismantling the supplied reference racer.
rules.purpose: A complete first route must exist economically as well as in a menu.

rules.statement: A project is optional and cancelable. Changing its goal neither edits the population nor reserves every potentially useful specimen forever.
rules.purpose: The player chooses what to pursue; the system records rather than commands ambition.

worked_definition.input: A hobbyist obtains Tin Can Special or an appropriate founder-style kit.
worked_definition.decision: Follow the included arrangement or change a visible permitted part; name and finish the host.
worked_definition.completion: The assembled roach enters an ordinary supported local event and has a valid result, including a possible loss.
worked_definition.next_routes: Buy a known replacement, inspect a rival, search the appropriate donor, begin a line, or keep racing. No route is a mandatory step toward enjoying the existing build.
worked_definition.failure: An invalid root is explained at the bench; losing the race does not retroactively invalidate the finished kit.

limits: Exact starter prices, supplies and initial event parameters need economy and novice-session calibration.
This volume does not guarantee that a supplied kit wins its first event.

systems.title: Foundry bench sessions: fast experimentation with real work
systems.problem: Separate fees and calendar advances for selection, assay, fitting and practice can punish learning several times for one intended adjustment.
systems.design_intent: Group ordinary preparation and testing into an intelligible workshop visit while preserving consumables, actual anatomy and consequential custom work.

rules.statement: A bench-session offer states supported hosts, services, care coverage, normal supplies and the time allowance before commitment. It is available as owned-workshop use or a club service.
rules.purpose: Costs correspond to performed work rather than a button-count tariff.

rules.statement: Draft inspection, comparison, selecting a recipe and undoing an uncommitted placement consume no anatomy, money or simulated production time. An actual test or preparation remains a world activity.
rules.purpose: A player can consider alternatives without paying for events that never happened.

rules.statement: Healthy pre-prepared exchange components can be refitted within the declared ordinary service allowance. New raw extraction, re-preparation, missing supplies or damaged interfaces trigger a separate visible quote.
rules.purpose: Routine experimentation is accessible while specialized labor remains valuable.

rules.statement: The visit advances world time according to its declared performed activities, not each interface gesture. Included supplies and test charges are counted once; extra runs outside the allowance require actual time and supplies.
rules.purpose: Broods continue and energy is consumed without multiplying rent, travel and preparation costs for one visit.

rules.statement: A compare card preserves the selected baseline, observed conditions and changed inputs. A stored reference is not another copy of its components and does not allow both builds to be fitted simultaneously with the same tissue.
rules.purpose: Rapid comparison retains ownership and causal meaning.

rules.statement: The primary report leads with finish, position or measured objective. It then offers the most relevant supported observation and competing explanations. It does not infer a gene from one lost corner.
rules.purpose: Feedback motivates another deliberate trial without misdiagnosing the entire animal.

rules.statement: Restoring an earlier build is possible only with still-owned, available components and the required procedure. Historical results remain available even when physical restoration is impossible.
rules.purpose: Undo can restore a draft; it cannot reverse a paid sale or regenerate an extracted organ.

rules.statement: Ordinary first demonstrations can be included in a kit or club visit. Precision load testing, destructive tests and certified batch work remain separate services when their extra information matters.
rules.purpose: Pay for useful additional certainty rather than for every first clue.

worked_definition.input: A Needle & Thread owner already holds a compatible alternative contact pair.
worked_definition.decision: Book normal bench use, record a matched reference, swap the ready contacts, run the same short course.
worked_definition.completion: A comparison records actual outcome and which contact observations changed.
worked_definition.next_routes: Keep the new pair, refit the earlier one, or investigate a different limiting component.
worked_definition.failure: A worse run costs its real included or additional resources; it does not create another whole visit charge for each UI action.

limits: The duration/allowance is a service parameter, not unlimited free physical testing.
No W15 change is applied to historical per-action fees or old cash ledgers.

systems.title: Useful mechanical opportunities instead of hidden equipment locks
systems.problem: Correct equations or anatomical descriptions are insufficient if the advertised action rarely works, cannot be read, or only solves a single mandatory obstacle.
systems.design_intent: Give each prominent construction recurring, understandable opportunities to race well, including genuine speed gains and conditional tactical choices.

rules.statement: A promoted component has a named opportunity envelope: relevant load, contact, supply, geometry, approach and available response. A course does not secretly activate its benefit by item ID.
rules.purpose: The same mechanism matters wherever its actual conditions occur.

rules.statement: Every published course challenge provides at least two physically plausible response families unless it is explicitly a specialist demonstration. The alternatives need not be equally fast or use identical budgets.
rules.purpose: A short landing can invite braking, changed approach/gearing or a different approved route rather than one obligatory rare part.

rules.statement: For a signature action, the reference defines an enabling case, a non-enabling case and a case where altered anatomy or fitting materially changes the outcome.
rules.purpose: A Hopper, Catchclaw or rail guide cannot be called successful design because its code branch exists.

rules.statement: A useful hop includes a loading opportunity, actual separation or route advantage, a reachable landing and recovered running. Available power and closing motion remain prerequisites, but the encounter repertoire must contain real opportunities to satisfy them.
rules.purpose: Do not hide timing failures behind a jump-win bonus or accept a flagship action that never occurs.

rules.statement: A grasping build describes reach, closing time, support and release. A held rival can cost both racers time; choosing when not to grasp is a legitimate race tendency.
rules.purpose: The original mantis response remains a contextual racing tactic, not an unconditional stun.

rules.statement: Display mass, drive, supply, geometry and action as related inputs. Preserve a genuinely faster or more efficient part when it is genuinely better; no compulsory compensating weakness is added to every discovery.
rules.purpose: Progress includes superiority as well as specialization.

rules.statement: A post-race explanation cites visible events and measured inputs under stated conditions. A component-only change and a whole-build change are different comparisons.
rules.purpose: A close victory remains a victory before it becomes an engineering report.

rules.statement: Courses are authored as racing spaces: clean running, traffic, surface transitions and maneuver windows coexist. Do not add an obstacle merely to sell its exclusive counter.
rules.purpose: Challenge should reward construction and decisions rather than enforce a shopping checklist.

worked_definition.input: A Last Laugh build on a mixed club course with a short shared straight and a longer unobstructed landing run.
worked_definition.decision: Choose a lower controllable hop for nearby traffic or remain running when no useful clearance exists.
worked_definition.completion: The observer can identify loading, a real positional change or failed attempt, landing and resumed pace.
worked_definition.next_routes: Improve synchronization, remount, change preload, adjust the drive/contact combination, or choose a different route.
worked_definition.failure: A late launch may fail, but the developer must also supply representative encounters where correct timing and the same anatomy can succeed.

limits: No new race solver, winner or numerical lap comparison is produced in this milestone.
Multi-roach contact, aerial motion and control fidelity still require implementation and human observation.

systems.title: One source ecology, several depths of collecting
systems.problem: Opaque genes, paid assays and several failure filters can make rare hunting a sequence of blind expenses; quick and spatial routes can also become unrelated worlds.
systems.design_intent: Make field expertise improve the decision to acquire a particular insect without manufacturing certainty or compulsory exploration.

rules.statement: Every collecting method names its actual source population and cohort. Quick and detailed visits use that relationship, or explicitly different nearby populations; one site cannot supply duplicate copies through two interfaces.
rules.purpose: The amount of interaction changes; the world identity does not.

rules.statement: Baseline observation reveals visible form, useful life stage, actual damage, accessible anatomy and contextual behavior. A short screen can disclose a bounded response under its conditions.
rules.purpose: The player has something useful to notice before buying precision.

rules.statement: Workshop measurements add controlled values; descendant evidence adds information about observed offspring. Neither an appearance nor a field movement claims exact hidden alleles.
rules.purpose: Preserve discovery and honest uncertainty rather than making the catalogue omniscient.

rules.statement: The field choice specifies desired anatomy, compatible containment, home capacity and at least one possible ordinary use. A general outing remains allowed and can return without profit.
rules.purpose: A rare target sits above useful ordinary possibilities rather than being the only nonzero outcome.

rules.statement: Probability review follows the whole route: encounter, visibility, approach, capture, preserved anatomy, useful stage, reproductive eligibility and eventual target. Do not independently lower every success rate until the product becomes unattainable.
rules.purpose: Challenge comes from selected decisions and scarce combinations, not unnoticed multiplication of punitive filters.

rules.statement: A competent method reduces its relevant uncertainty or damage; it does not improve the genome after capture. Individual outcomes stay fixed once the corresponding world event occurs.
rules.purpose: Knowledge can make a search better without a generic luck stat.

rules.statement: Buying a measured part, an observed founder or a declared reproductive unit is the reliable acquisition alternative for a player who does not enjoy repeated searches. Neither route grants an intrinsic quality premium.
rules.purpose: Rare exploration remains an option, not an obligation for every competitive build.

rules.statement: A return report separates cash changes from secured stock, preserved anatomy, observations and continuing home costs. One useful ordinary animal is not automatically cash, and one informative glimpse is not ownership.
rules.purpose: The player can judge what the outing actually achieved.

rules.statement: Useful-stage catches receive an intelligible next-action window and an accessible supported holding/preparation option in the relevant settlement. Its exact limits belong to the donor profile.
rules.purpose: A special stage creates a choice instead of an unavoidable surprise expiration after returning.

worked_definition.input: A high-purchase Glassfoot line lacks quick release; the Glazed Overgrowth source is known.
worked_definition.decision: Inspect unloading and peel behavior, preserve pads, and keep a promising moderate-grip animal as a candidate founder.
worked_definition.completion: The same animal returns; a field note says what was seen and does not certify the entire genotype.
worked_definition.next_routes: Controlled assay, direct pad preparation, breeding, trade or collection.
worked_definition.failure: A damaged pad may lose direct-use value while the animal’s reproductive eligibility is evaluated separately.

limits: Population biology and exact encounter distributions are donor-monograph work.
Quick mode need not guarantee equal catch counts or equal information; it must disclose differences in method, time, cost and preservation.

systems.title: Split-brood projects: research, current use and sale in one line
systems.problem: An ambitious breeding target can turn most offspring into apparent failures and turn every batch into more protected mouths to feed.
systems.design_intent: Give a line intermediate achievements and an explicit, bounded disposition plan without trivializing inheritance or automatically choosing all valuable animals.

rules.statement: A project records the desired eventual construction, current missing contribution and available evidence separately. A candidate parent is judged by the contribution it can plausibly add, not required to be the final product.
rules.purpose: Preserve the weak-jumper/good-synchronization opportunity.

rules.statement: Recognize four distinct milestones: a plausible founder contribution, observed expression in descendants, a useful combined individual, and repeat observed output meeting a named specification. None implies the next has already happened.
rules.purpose: Progress becomes visible before an entire line is perfected.

rules.statement: The brood plan allocates possible mature output among research review, personal components, funded ordinary supply and replacement candidates. Those are goals for real outcomes, not guarantees of counts or sexes.
rules.purpose: A mixed generation can serve several purposes without cloning bodies.

rules.statement: A replacement policy targets a maintained reserve by role and condition rather than adding two permanent keepers from every brood. If the reserve is already filled, additional candidates request a deliberate substitution, display, sale or retention choice.
rules.purpose: Reliable production does not automatically become an ever-growing stock liability.

rules.statement: Research holds take priority over automated ordinary dispatch only through explicit project criteria and consent. Unknown potentially interesting stock may go to Review; the player can choose an ordinary unscreened sales policy.
rules.purpose: Automation remains useful without pretending it knows which hidden genomes are worthless.

rules.statement: Useful nonpremium output has a current purpose named before the final rare target is balanced: ordinary Hoppers, joint-only material, complementary breeders or a customer’s narrower requirement.
rules.purpose: A failed ultimate combination need not be a failed whole project.

rules.statement: Paired reproductive roles, fertility, survival, inherited combinations and product acceptance remain separate. The player may buy a known compatible unit or seek another founder; repeated failure does not conjure a perfect pair.
rules.purpose: A reliable acquisition option supports continued agency while biological risk stays meaningful.

rules.statement: A production claim uses the customer’s actual question and records relevant tested offspring and distinct broods. The measured sample is not automatically an unbiased rate for all future offspring.
rules.purpose: A line name can develop trust without becoming a stat or price aura.

rules.statement: Changing a project creates a new target branch with preserved old observations. Existing siblings can become useful under that new purpose without acquiring new genes.
rules.purpose: New ambitions reopen the value of familiar stock and records.

worked_definition.input: A high-return/ordinary-synchrony Hopper founder and an ordinary-return/high-synchrony founder.
worked_definition.decision: Retain the useful complement and set an ordinary component outlet beside the premium combination goal.
worked_definition.completion: A brood produces actual individuals. Some may meet ordinary assembly requirements; others justify further selection; replacements fill only the chosen reserve.
worked_definition.next_routes: Fit a personal assembly, supply an ordinary kit maker, continue a selected branch, or close the project.
worked_definition.failure: An all-one-role brood or failed attempt remains real. A pre-existing racer and purchased supplies let other play continue rather than requiring the brood to succeed first.

limits: No genetic probabilities are newly assigned here; species-specific inheritance replaces neither research nor later balancing.
The plan creates useful decisions, not guaranteed profitable or target-matching offspring.

systems.title: Facilities as controlled commitments rather than perpetual chores
systems.problem: More facilities or animals can increase recurring obligations faster than the available strategic choices, undermining both casual ownership and productive specialization.
systems.design_intent: Let players choose research, production or maintenance activity using the same biology and owned facilities, with visible bounded commitments.

rules.statement: Research, production and maintenance are operating plans, not exclusive buildings or professions. The same suitable nursery can change plans between actual commitments.
rules.purpose: Depth comes from use and allocation, not another forced upgrade tier.

rules.statement: Research prioritizes observation and selected candidates; production prioritizes a named accepted-output specification and bounded replacements; maintenance stops new reproductive starts and supports existing stock.
rules.purpose: Stopping expansion becomes an intelligible option before a cash crisis.

rules.statement: Committed living stages and future holding are reserved through actual supported capacity. An expected low survivor count does not provide physical room for a larger viable cohort.
rules.purpose: Simplified presentation must preserve real obligations.

rules.statement: The breeder can split or schedule production only where the form’s reproductive and handling profile permits it. Any unselected eggs or young still receive a stated disposition; they do not vanish to fit a forecast.
rules.purpose: Scheduling is an operational choice, not a disguised biological deletion.

rules.statement: A breeder or racer may pay a suitable service for grow-out, supported holding, preservation or temporary boarding. Ownership, delivered stock, fees, responsibility and return conditions are stated.
rules.purpose: Different player interests can access expertise without running every facility themselves.

rules.statement: A readiness card states the first real blocker, committed care and the next supported transition. It does not show an unobserved exact survivor count disguised as a precise future bill.
rules.purpose: Planning remains useful without leaking the engine’s future knowledge.

rules.statement: Routine care executes through selected supplies and services without repeated identical manual inputs. A new problem calls for intervention only when it changes an actual outcome.
