rules.purpose: Large operations create choices about capacity, stock and customers rather than proportional feeding clicks.

rules.statement: Offline world time pauses by default. During in-world absence, agreed services and care progress with the same calendar; no life is frozen selectively to evade a contract.
rules.purpose: Stopping the application is safe, but ignoring an in-world living obligation is still a decision.

rules.statement: Arrears recovery, aging and lasting injury require separate authored material profiles. This milestone permits no hidden disappearance, universal immortality, automatic regeneration or punitive loss added to solve a balance issue.
rules.purpose: Consequences remain grounded in the intended world rather than emergency design patches.

worked_definition.input: A successful ordinary-stock line has filled its replacement reserve and lacks funded orders for the next batch.
worked_definition.decision: Switch to maintenance or select a smaller supported commitment; optionally book outside capacity for a genuinely useful order.
worked_definition.completion: Existing stock remains cared for; no new batch starts without consent and capacity.
worked_definition.next_routes: Race a prepared host, seek a new customer, improve the line or display selected stock.
worked_definition.failure: Unsold animals cost resources. The plan reveals that obligation before extra production rather than disguising it as passive revenue.

limits: This is a service and reference design, not an executed scheduler.
Exact care prices, mortality and dormant-storage behavior are unresolved until the relevant biology chapter is authored.

systems.title: Progression in useful differences, not five decorative labels
systems.problem: A conjunction-based grade can hide meaningful single-axis improvement, while a small allele alphabet may never populate the advertised intermediate bands.
systems.design_intent: Keep meaningful qualification but make actual improvements, operating variants and recognizable new mechanisms independent progression rewards.

rules.statement: Every product presents four separate questions: what function it supplies, how its observed properties compare, which declared operating profile it meets, and what appearance or history makes it desirable.
rules.purpose: Neither rare color nor a high headline band answers every question.

rules.statement: Within-profile improvement is visible even when the qualification band stays unchanged. Show the actual improved axis and the criterion still limiting the next band.
rules.purpose: A better offspring can feel and be useful before crossing a catalogue threshold.

rules.statement: Hobby, Club, Circuit, Premier and Apex remain names for demonstrated protocols where those steps are meaningful. A donor profile is not required to occupy every label until its supported variation and acquisition routes make them useful.
rules.purpose: Do not fabricate reachable progression by relabeling identical anatomy.

rules.statement: New morphological or preparation variants require changed physical geometry, contact, movement or recognizable collection purpose. Their inheritance, prevalence and preparation belong to the source profile.
rules.purpose: A forked horn or channelled pad must be more than a recolored percentage buff.

rules.statement: Geometry and operating choices remain ranges, not globally higher-better scores. Mechanical advantage, reach and braking friction may require different target bands for different projects.
rules.purpose: Maintain useful tuning decisions while allowing actual quality improvement within the chosen operating range.

rules.statement: A superior part can improve several useful properties at equal burden. Keep that discovery unless a real mechanical interaction explains a limit; do not impose an unrelated weakness as a tax for progress.
rules.purpose: The player can legitimately seek the faster roach.

rules.statement: Review component families against native baselines, affordable alternatives, representative courses and full-build mass/supply. An item-only improvement that is always useless after installation needs redesign or honest specialist positioning.
rules.purpose: The part has to matter where players use it.

rules.statement: Performance qualification does not alter genetics, event legality or buyer payments by itself. Buyers can choose a measured profile as an acceptance shorthand but retain a real purpose and price.
rules.purpose: The label informs a transaction; it is not a universal rarity economy.

worked_definition.input: A Glassfoot descendant improves peel release while remaining in the current contact qualification band because dusty purchase is still below the next threshold.
worked_definition.decision: Use the faster release now, retain it as a parent, or sell it for an order concerned with clean track performance.
worked_definition.completion: Its measured difference remains visible and can feed the same installed contact model.
worked_definition.next_routes: Pursue dusty purchase, a different profile or a visual variant rather than repeating an identical generic upgrade.
worked_definition.failure: A changed grade name without different anatomy or useful measurement is rejected as progression polish.

limits: No new trait range, mutation rate or band frequency is treated as calibrated.
Comparative use and player recognition must be tested; complete product monographs remain the source of inheritance detail.

systems.title: Three distinct maker businesses, not one subsidized crafting funnel
systems.problem: The documented first maker project succeeded in delivery and lost cash; calling its sale passive income would conceal a real incentive problem.
systems.design_intent: Design distinct service, manufactured-kit and breeder-supply businesses around their actual value and costs, with an accessible earning route that does not require breeding.

rules.statement: Customer-stock fitting is a first-class commission. The client supplies and retains ownership of a named host and components; the fitter is paid for agreed preparation, arrangement and evidence.
rules.purpose: A player can earn through building expertise without purchasing and financing an entire second racer.

rules.statement: A manufactured-kit order purchases actual material stock, the living foundation, preparation, coordination and guide. A template match alone is not delivered work.
rules.purpose: Repeatable production has a product people can assemble, not an abstract crafting completion.

rules.statement: A breeder-supply order purchases live eligible animals and the stated evidence. It is priced and accepted separately from their potential extracted parts.
rules.purpose: Fertility, compatible roles and reliable output can have economic value independent of peak race performance.

rules.statement: Quote three separate quantities: incremental cost of the next delivery, allocated ongoing business overhead, and still-unrecovered research/capital spending. Purchased inputs, own-stock opportunity value and consumed supplies are labeled distinctly.
rules.purpose: A profitable next batch and a profitable lifetime project are not the same claim.

rules.statement: A fixed contract price is agreed before irreversible production. A forecast shows what assumptions make it affordable; the customer does not magically reimburse bad breeding outcomes or choose a hidden perfect sale value.
rules.purpose: Risk remains meaningful and understandable.

rules.statement: Where current terms cannot pay a competent repeat supplier for its necessary costs, redesign the quantity, input sourcing, service scope or buyer budget. Do not hide the loss as experience or relabel consumed working stock as permanent capital.
rules.purpose: At least one deliberate ordinary livelihood must actually support upkeep under reasonable play.

rules.statement: Kit-maker source requirements match the intended use. A starter commission does not demand exhaustive ancestry certification; a premium breeder claim may require multiple observed broods.
rules.purpose: Evidence cost belongs where it buys relevant confidence.

rules.statement: Retail and wholesale prices reflect different real duties: selection, care, presentation, warranty or fitting work, and customer demand. Same-counter posted-order spread checks may support transaction safety but do not define every world price.
rules.purpose: Fix the economic cause instead of increasing all prices whenever a player finds an opportunity.

rules.statement: Legitimate resale from place, timing, information, preparation or service can earn money. Repeating the same transfer without new value, a changed real buyer need or new funding cannot generate an endless self-financed return.
rules.purpose: Commerce stays interesting without ledger exploits or blanket anti-trading restrictions.

rules.statement: Compare buyer-only, catcher, breeder and fitter routes with matched starting resources, available time and product objective. Include failed attempts, care of leftovers, resale opportunities and retained assets separately.
rules.purpose: Different route schedules are not evidence that one profession is superior.

worked_definition.input: An independent fitter receives a client-owned Lowline and two measured compatible drive/contact options.
worked_definition.decision: Agree which construction or matched measurement is wanted, inspect actual supplied condition and quote the work.
worked_definition.completion: The fitted host and actual observation return to the customer; a service receipt pays labor and consumed supplies.
worked_definition.next_routes: Accept another job, use earnings for personal parts, or develop a complete commercial kit with separately sourced inventory.
worked_definition.failure: If the supplied component cannot meet the requested outcome, decline or renegotiate before destructive work; no fabricated improvement is awarded.

limits: No new price list, profit rate or customer budget is claimed as balanced.
W12’s -38-credit result remains unchanged evidence. A revised definition is not a retroactive refund.

systems.title: Ordinary stock and alternate anatomy have named uses
systems.problem: Ordinary catches can be nominally saleable yet have no available buyer; a research-oriented interface can also classify every non-target specimen as useless.
systems.design_intent: Make quick disposal of genuine surplus useful without turning every living thing into guaranteed cash or erasing valuable anatomical alternatives.

rules.statement: Stock is evaluated separately for immediate assembly, breeding contribution, funded product demand, collection and remaining material. One missing target does not automatically fail every purpose.
rules.purpose: The keep-good/sell-unwanted rhythm becomes informed rather than rarity-only.

rules.statement: Ordinary buyers publish the forms, stages, intact anatomy and quantities they need for starter stock, replacement components or other stated uses. Their budgets come from actual trade or an explicit authored economic boundary.
rules.purpose: Common stock has deliberate demand instead of an unbounded money-conversion slot.

rules.statement: Alternative preparation outlets name the exact region and useful measurements. A poor complete jumper may provide acceptable landing joints; low drive value does not prove that a scarab’s separate plates are poor.
rules.purpose: Brood and field surplus can feed more than the premium goal.

rules.statement: Damaged stock can be unsuitable for one product and still valuable as a breeder, display object or supported alternate preparation. Only actually remaining usable anatomy can be offered.
rules.purpose: Damage is local and consequential, not an all-purpose zero-price tag.

rules.statement: An unmarketable animal is not assigned an invented universal feed or salvage buyer. Retention, supported placement, release where the authored ecology allows it, or another declared disposition remains necessary.
rules.purpose: The economy has limits without making discarded anatomy reappear.

rules.statement: Quick-sale previews the actual eligible identities and selected buyer quote, excluding protected founders, chosen displays, committed operations, kits and installed parts. The player may deliberately override a relevant protection.
rules.purpose: Routine volume is easy while rare or personally important stock remains under control.

rules.statement: When a buyer is temporarily full, offer only real alternatives: another known purpose or buyer, later scheduled demand, preparation, or retention. A persistent shortage signals a production decision, not an automatic universal price collapse.
rules.purpose: Saturation creates strategy without shutting every earning route through one wallet.

rules.statement: Return summaries attribute money, ongoing home sales, care, captures and knowledge separately. Repeated appraisals do not reroll the animal or generate additional stock.
rules.purpose: The player can identify whether a run, a brood or an independent sale paid for the next upgrade.

worked_definition.input: A Switchyard outing returns an excellent synchrony candidate, an ordinary intact Hopper and one specimen with a damaged launch region but eligible reproduction.
worked_definition.decision: Reserve the first for a line, sell the ordinary donor against actual stock demand, and evaluate the damaged animal’s reproductive or alternate remaining-anatomy use.
worked_definition.completion: All three receive explicit dispositions; the sale is one real receipt and the retained animals remain obligations.
worked_definition.next_routes: Use proceeds immediately, continue the line or obtain an assay only where it could change a decision.
worked_definition.failure: A requested intact complete assembly cannot be fulfilled by relabeling the damaged donor.

limits: Prices and volume must be calibrated jointly with stock generation and care.
No ordinary route is guaranteed profit on every outing.

systems.title: A sold kit returns to the hobby through a real recipient
systems.problem: A closed sale changes money and ownership but may provide no visible payoff that the maker’s work mattered to another hobbyist.
systems.design_intent: Connect delivered work to permitted use, recognition and a specific next need without autonomous hype bonuses or forced quests.

rules.statement: Each significant customer has a current purpose, relevant knowledge, budget source and intended use. The purpose selects the order, not an arbitrary global reputation threshold.
rules.purpose: A known club regular can want a starter tin while a broodworks wants compatible selected founders.

rules.statement: A delivered product retains its host and component identities under the recipient. A later local race, display, repair request or revised commission may refer to that same product.
rules.purpose: The maker sees actual use rather than a cloned commemorative image.

rules.statement: Post-sale appearances require the recipient’s ownership, readiness, schedule and relevant permission. A sold racer cannot be shown simultaneously in two incompatible events or returned to the seller’s inventory by a notice.
rules.purpose: Social feedback obeys the same world as practical play.

rules.statement: Repeat demand is generated from an unmet purpose, consumed stock, an expanding activity, a requested variation or a genuine reorder after use. It requires a new budget and real delivery.
rules.purpose: Recognition can create opportunity without directly paying money.

rules.statement: Trust can change transaction friction: known fit ranges, reduced repeated inspection when evidence is still valid, reserved work slots or negotiated payment terms. A trust claim does not change genes or waive a failed functional requirement.
rules.purpose: Reputation affects relationships rather than acting as a universal price or power multiplier.

rules.statement: A product-family revision states which promise changes and who benefits. Earlier sold editions retain their original contents and claims. Substitution of a new donor must still satisfy the intended construction.
rules.purpose: The maker develops a recognizable catalogue, not disposable generic crafts.

rules.statement: Unknown outcomes stay unknown. A winning recipient does not certify genetic causality; a losing recipient can still have received the product it correctly ordered.
rules.purpose: Repeat orders and complaints distinguish workmanship, stated performance and competition.

rules.statement: Not every sale creates a scripted appearance. Prioritize a few remembered customers whose continuing activity is legible; ordinary wholesale can remain aggregated behind explicit budget and demand boundaries.
rules.purpose: World scale need not multiply bespoke scenes or make every trade an obligatory storyline.

worked_definition.input: Two Nets receives a Last Laugh-style kit made from a different host and the maker’s ordinary qualifying brood output.
worked_definition.decision: An identified club buyer obtains and assembles it, choosing their own number and finish.
worked_definition.completion: A later owner-permitted club card shows that actual host and maker mark, with its own result.
worked_definition.next_routes: The buyer asks for an alternate contact set for ash; another customer requests a similar tin; the maker can accept or decline.
worked_definition.failure: A paid original receipt cannot be reused as funding for a new order, and no automatic audience size establishes a price premium.

limits: These are world and content definitions; NPC purchase, assembly and schedule execution are not implemented here.
Relatedness research does not establish that an NPC use notice equals a human social relationship.

systems.title: A permanent local hobby inside an earned championship ladder
systems.problem: Finite funded prototype editions and long mirrored programmes risk becoming the only meaning of racing, leaving no ordinary return loop after the player finishes a list.
systems.design_intent: Keep local competition and experimentation continuous while funding, special prizes and official advancement remain meaningful.

rules.statement: Separate bench trials, casual practice/rival races, funded meets, qualifying events and exhibitions. Each states which outcome it records and which reward or advancement it can actually award.
rules.purpose: Every real finish matters within its context without paying an infinite purse.

rules.statement: Clubs continue practice, informal rivalry, trade and display outside a championship edition. Availability depends on the place and its resources, not exhaustion of a three-entry prototype list.
rules.purpose: The world-popular hobby remains after a player completes a particular programme.

rules.statement: A renewed sponsored event requires funding, participants, usable course and operating support. Its new edition can award a new real prize; replay of an old edition cannot.
rules.purpose: Repeat participation is genuine activity, not duplicated settlement.

rules.statement: The championship path remains Locals, Regionals, Factionals and representation at New World City. Those qualifications control their competitions, not the existence or purchase of genes, tools or donor forms.
rules.purpose: Competitive prestige does not force every hobbyist into the same career.

rules.statement: Open preserves build freedom; Speedsters restrict dedicated weapons; Fireworks requires functional offense and light carapace; sustained Flyers race Flyers. No runtime absence deletes a division from the reference universe.
rules.purpose: The original class identities survive later technical choices.

rules.statement: Every event monograph specifies actual field interaction, roster, starting treatment, allowed between-round changes, progression and intended session burden. Sequential mirrored pairs are one option, not a claim of simultaneous pack physics or a universal beginner format.
rules.purpose: Sporting purpose determines the programme; a solver convenience does not dictate the whole world.

rules.statement: A loss preserves its truthful classification and can still produce observed performance, a personal record or relevant experience. It does not automatically pay a consolation purse or guarantee useful stock.
rules.purpose: Feedback supports another attempt without making defeat meaningless.

rules.statement: Preparation information is accessible before entry. Rivals use declared constructions and bounded knowledge rather than reading the player’s hidden genome for a perfect counter.
rules.purpose: Improvement and inspection reward actual understanding.

rules.statement: A season introduces new opponents, published layouts, stock activity and product interests without erasing the player’s specimens, line work or permanent records. Offline default pause remains.
rules.purpose: There is an inviting reason to return without a compulsory reset or real-world attendance streak.

worked_definition.input: A local Open champion has claimed that edition’s donor reward and spent its remaining sponsored entries.
worked_definition.decision: Continue ordinary club racing, prepare for the earned Regional event, host an exhibition or campaign another build.
worked_definition.completion: A new real event records new results; an exhausted prize edition remains historical.
worked_definition.next_routes: A new funded programme or different local activity provides a fresh challenge when actually available.
worked_definition.failure: The reference does not allow a player-authored easy course or old replay to mint official qualification.

limits: No new points table, Factional roster, aerial solver or infinite budget is authored as completed here.
Timing and programme size need human trials; mirrored pairs must not be advertised as pack racing.

systems.title: Collections, recognizable work and projects worth keeping
systems.problem: Aesthetic value and affection have been correctly protected from stat bonuses, but need their own complete activities and visible outcomes.
systems.design_intent: Give personal builds and collections actual acquisition, finishing, display, preservation and recognition loops.

rules.statement: A collection project names a desired form, appearance, provenance, construction tradition or personal relation. It need not name a faster race time.
rules.purpose: The player may keep a beautiful ordinary animal for a valid independent purpose.

rules.statement: A finished display includes the actual specimen or assembly, a selected presentation, and an honest label distinguishing natural appearance, applied finish, descendant stock, original material and reproduction.
rules.purpose: Collectibility is concrete rather than an unexplained rarity glow.

rules.statement: A club display, commissioned finish or owner-permitted publication can recognize the work without awarding inherited power. A cash prize or collector sale requires an actual funded event or buyer.
rules.purpose: Recognition does not have to be monetized to matter.

rules.statement: Natural appearance inheritance is a donor/host profile question, while paint and fitted composition belong to construction. This milestone adds no appearance-genetics algorithm by implication.
rules.purpose: Visual identity is preserved without undocumented biological claims.

rules.statement: Maintain the reference racer after publishing its design. Future maker kits use different stock; a remembered win remains attached to its actual host and historical configuration.
rules.purpose: Production expands an identity rather than consuming the thing the player became attached to.

rules.statement: An inactive owned racer can be maintained, boarded, prepared for another division, displayed, used in eligible breeding, or deliberately offered through a later complete-racer transaction. None is automatic.
rules.purpose: A stable offers more ways to enjoy ownership instead of only more upkeep.

rules.statement: Retired or damaged material can remain meaningful as a trophy, original part or restoration reference, provided its condition is not misrepresented.
rules.purpose: A changing competitive frontier need not erase every older project’s value.

rules.statement: Presentation first distinguishes the whole silhouette and the working anatomy; optional detail preserves lineage, maker, edition and race history. Do not bury the creature beneath transaction identifiers.
rules.purpose: The same object is recognizable on the bench, in a case, at the counter and on the starting line.

worked_definition.input: An Ashveil donor has a striking pattern but ordinary aero measurements.
worked_definition.decision: Keep it alive for display or prepare an explicitly appearance-led piece if desired, rather than claim that the pattern improves hold-down.
worked_definition.completion: A finished collection entry or commissioned visual build is exhibited under an honest label.
worked_definition.next_routes: Seek a complementary natural form, make a matching tin, commission a finish or return to competitive builds.
worked_definition.failure: A record of beauty cannot certify heredity, original provenance or performance that was never demonstrated.

limits: No human attachment or collector price effect is established by this reference.
Broad retirement, complete-racer selling and appearance inheritance remain separate development chapters.

systems.title: Closure, useful next projects and a readable current reference
systems.problem: A broad world can end a session with a pile of obligations and make resumption feel like accounting before play.
systems.design_intent: Let the player finish something, stop safely and return to a self-chosen meaningful action, while maintaining an unambiguous development reference.

rules.statement: A completed project records its actual result: named build, race, captured stock, selected brood, fulfilled delivery or displayed piece. It does not immediately replace that result with a compulsory next checklist.
rules.purpose: Success remains perceivable rather than vanishing beneath new demands.

rules.statement: The player may retain one current next intention and optional later interests. These are pointers to existing sources, builds and obligations, not newly granted resources or permanently reserved all-purpose candidates.
rules.purpose: The next session begins with a reason to act, not a memory test.

rules.statement: Before leaving, show unstarted production plans, already living care obligations, protected stock and accepted deadlines separately. The user may stop new starts or select an appropriate care plan.
rules.purpose: Closing the application does not demand a long inventory-cleaning ritual.

rules.statement: Default offline pause stops the world calendar consistently. Resuming does not charge unplayed days, destroy stock, reset streaks or award unearned production.
rules.purpose: The return incentive is an attractive project rather than fear of absence.

rules.statement: In-world waiting advances the relevant care, development and customer schedules together. It cannot advance profits while freezing expenses or preserve one larval stage without its actual supporting method.
rules.purpose: Convenience preserves the world’s material relationships.

rules.statement: Return information leads with the chosen project and completed changes since the prior in-world activity, followed by only actionable blockers. Expert records remain available.
rules.purpose: Optional depth does not mean every entry begins as an administrative dashboard.

rules.statement: For downstream readers, W15 amendments override only their named qualitative interpretations. Author premises govern; prior measured examples, code and histories remain unchanged.
rules.purpose: One current reading route prevents a prototype number from silently becoming universe law.

rules.statement: Every future content addition states the immediate pleasure it enables, the longer project it supports, the actual object it changes, and its acceptance question. A feature with only maintenance costs and no new useful decision is revised before expansion.
rules.purpose: The next wave continues integrated design instead of adding isolated systems for their own sake.

worked_definition.input: A player finishes a club race while an ordinary brood matures at home.
worked_definition.decision: Enjoy the result, retain the intent to inspect one missing breeding contribution, and pause new production if current demand is full.
worked_definition.completion: The racer, matured stock, cash and commitments remain exactly recorded when the world pauses.
worked_definition.next_routes: On return, inspect that brood, race again or choose another project.
worked_definition.failure: The game may not manufacture an offline loss to force attendance or pretend that a saved intention is completed work.

limits: No user-engagement outcome is established until actual readers and players are studied.
The rule concerns default participation; any alternate clock mode needs its own explicitly chosen conditions.

construction_families.title: Tin Can Special — finish a personally owned racer
construction_families.reference_function: Chosen vehicle/body, complete kit, appearance and local racing.
construction_families.construction: A suitable Lowline or declared alternative host, the printed first contact or guide upgrade, and explicit retained native functions.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: Complete the actual assembly, choose a name/finish, and enter an ordinary run.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Service-gallery hosts are selected for useful proportions and native characteristics; everyday kits buy consistent appropriate stock rather than requiring rare founders.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: One later contact, drive or handling change can be useful before a full specialist conversion is owned.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Two Nets buys dependable whole hosts and ordinary compatible preparations for affordable complete tins.
representative_opportunities: Native-ready first run
Same-host before/after one contact change
Personal finishing or a local rival
construction_families.disconfirming_case: A native-only host may be preferable to a badly fitted upgrade; a beginner kit must not require every organ replaced.
construction_families.visible_recognition: The owner recognizes the same named animal on the bench and starting line; the finish and actual race result are not buried by future tasks.

construction_families.title: Needle & Thread — pace that can be used
construction_families.reference_function: Motor, tire/contact choice and body geometry.
construction_families.construction: Narrow host, useful drive musculature, quick-release feet and retained native roles.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: Observe faster useful stepping or a genuine matched-run improvement from the chosen contribution.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Root-furnace cicadas provide cadence/force/efficiency; Glassfoot stock provides purchase/release. Seek the actual bottleneck, not the loudest insect or highest adhesion.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: An efficient ordinary-cadence drive or a faster-releasing ordinary-grip foot can be a useful donor, direct component or complementary breeder.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Sprint-kit makers can buy measured contact pairs or drives independently; a fitting customer may already own the good motor.
representative_opportunities: Straight acceleration with adequate supply
A contact-limited build before and after release improvement
A populated bend with real passing width
construction_families.disconfirming_case: A better motor cannot force a stuck foot to release or erase inadequate supply; this does not make all superior motors compulsory sidegrades.
construction_families.visible_recognition: Stride cadence, slipping and release are readable; a comparison identifies the changed component rather than an unexplained overall power tier.

construction_families.title: Glassline — hold, release, then correct
construction_families.reference_function: Contact compound and stabilizing support serve different purposes.
construction_families.construction: Useful foot material plus sensing connected to available response anatomy; a brace is a separately chosen physical support construction.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: The feet retain useful contact while cycling, and a sensed disturbance produces an observable available correction.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Glazed Overgrowth supplies contact stock; Damp Service Voids supplies paired sensor anatomy. Select a missing contact contribution or useful latency rather than a shared rarity color.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: A moderate-grip/fast-release founder can improve an already gripping line; ordinary pairs can serve beginner contacts or alternate brake strips.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Two Nets supplies contact sets; fitters align paired sensors; appropriate material can enter Apron brake orders instead of pretending all output is premium feet.
representative_opportunities: A load where feet can hold and release
A disturbance with an available corrective limb
The same disturbance with that limb committed elsewhere
construction_families.disconfirming_case: An excellent sensor does not supply force or create contact while suspended; a brace must reach a real surface.
construction_families.visible_recognition: The contact, cue and correction are distinct visible events, not three identical balance effects.

construction_families.title: Foundry Heavy / Lowstep — working force through a supported body
construction_families.reference_function: Motor force, gear ratio, chassis support and contact material.
construction_families.construction: Suitable loaded host; Torque Bundle; target-range Lowstep; oriented Boxbrace; actual surface-appropriate feet.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: Improved launch, climbing or recovery under the declared load where the construction has adequate contact.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Cooling compost scarabs for specific force/support; Ballast crickets for suitable leverage, cleats and articulation. A bigger ratio is a different operating choice, not a universal tier.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: A stock animal may supply disjoint hip/toe products or drive/support material when preserved. Unneeded high-force stock may suit another host rather than be discarded.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Cinderhouse can supply useful force and support separately; local loose-surface clubs create ordinary cleat demand; fitters earn for correct load paths.
representative_opportunities: Loaded restart
Climb with sufficient ground purchase
Loose-surface recovery after contact
construction_families.disconfirming_case: Long uninterrupted straights can expose limited stride travel. Unsupported plates do not provide useful root bracing or whole-body armor.
construction_families.visible_recognition: The body pushes and recovers visibly; the working structure remains coherent under load rather than simply displaying a larger strength number.

construction_families.title: Last Laugh / Third Friend — source, breed, build, leap, return
construction_families.reference_function: Useful power delivery, suspension and damping from PCR/Tamiya, integrated with RRR-native active jumping.
construction_families.construction: Complete launch-capable hind system; adequate work and reserve; working orientation; planned receiving contact; separate damper only where included.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: A properly timed hop clears an actual obstacle or rival and returns the animal to useful running.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Switchyard stock is selected independently for return, synchronization and settling. A complete kit can be bought; a complementary field founder can serve a longer project.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: Plausible synchronization → observed descendant expression → usable combined individual → repeated qualified output. Ordinary assemblies and joint-only preparations remain valid before perfection.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Third Friend tins, selected founder requests, ordinary landing parts and measured fitting work use different outcomes from the same project.
representative_opportunities: Clear legal crossing with no rival required
Closing pass with a viable load/release window
Landing under matched stored work and body mass
construction_families.disconfirming_case: A ceiling, inaccessible takeoff or occupied landing can invalidate that opportunity. No auto-pass compensates for poor mechanics, and no single selected gene guarantees the entire action.
construction_families.visible_recognition: Loading, release, air passage, receiving contact and recovery are visible; useful intermediate behavior can be noticed before a full-lap advantage.

construction_families.title: Apron — useful contact in two different places
construction_families.reference_function: Physical-hobby contact brakes and wall guides, not additional hidden Gaiden slots.
construction_families.construction: A pad with real clearance/compliance and a supported rail guide from separate required material.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: Approach contact removes excessive speed; guide contact reduces loss at an actual wall.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Sandfelt stock from Feltworks for material/compression; darklings from Underpipe Aprons for sliding surface/support; Glassfoot pads can be allocated to Gripstrips alternatively.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: A dependable middle operating range can serve many ordinary builds. Better low-loss surface at adequate support is a genuine improvement; larger friction alone is not.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Material specialists supply stock; a fitter sells engagement/alignment; a trackmaker provides a course where multiple setup solutions are possible.
representative_opportunities: Same approach with pad engaged and raised
Same rail encounter with supported guide and native shell
Same guide away from the rail
construction_families.disconfirming_case: A long safe landing or another approach can make the pad unnecessary. A noncontact guide has no speed aura. Passive launch does not spend a nonexistent Hopper charge.
construction_families.visible_recognition: The visible point of contact precedes the effect; the result is not inferred from equipment presence.

construction_families.title: Flashboil — race-winning contact, not an elimination mode
construction_families.reference_function: Racing power, supply and physical construction extended by RRR’s original derby identity.
construction_families.construction: Light protective construction; working offense; supported roots and finite action resources; native or supplied ordinary movement.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: A timed physical interaction opens or protects race position while the racer continues toward a valid finish.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Mantis closing time at working reach, horn-root support/contact geometry, or dependable bombardier valves are distinct breeder goals. A collector may still prefer a different striking form.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: An ordinary dependable arm or valve can serve a local build; a premium research line can pursue range/timing combinations without making ordinary attacks unusable.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Fireworks builders, repair/material suppliers and specialist kit makers purchase specific functional assemblies.
representative_opportunities: Reachable aligned contact
A missed early/late commitment
A successful contact whose time cost still matters to the race
construction_families.disconfirming_case: A distant opponent cannot be damaged by completing an animation; dedicated weapons remain excluded in Speedsters; finish order, not kill count, decides the race.
construction_families.visible_recognition: Wind-up, reach, contact, effect on both racers and recovery remain visible. Spectacle does not require obscuring the race with constant effects.

construction_families.title: Skyhook — the same hobby expressed through flight
construction_families.reference_function: The kit’s output, delivery, structure, reserve and control roles remain; powered flight is RRR-native, not the passive front-wing slot.
construction_families.construction: Host; working flight surfaces/roots; drive and wingstroke linkage; adequate supply; control; launch and landing provisions.
construction_families.immediate_payoff: Assemble a genuine aerial racer that traverses a declared gate course against other flyers.
construction_families.source_and_selection: Pond/emergence quality, wing-root behavior, sustained work and appropriate reproductive stock create different sourcing needs from ground kits.
construction_families.intermediate_progress: Ordinary intact wing sets, root preparations and complete starter flight kits permit participation while experts pursue coordinated high-output constructions.
construction_families.commercial_outlet: Pond breeders, emergence services, kit makers, carriers and Flyer venues all have distinct useful outputs.
representative_opportunities: Sustained legal flight
A controlled turn/gate approach
Safe supported landing
construction_families.disconfirming_case: A raised ground sprite, passive foil or prolonged hop is not powered flight. The full donor life history and aerial implementation remain future work.
construction_families.visible_recognition: The gate, wing-root action and body attitude explain the maneuver; this remains a compendium acceptance requirement, not a claim of a new playable division.

physical_objects.title: A chosen project, not a compulsory quest log
physical_objects.physical_brief: A small card clipped to a racer case, donor tank or workshop project. Its front bears the actual creature or intended construction; the back carries optional technical notes.
records: Missing contribution or next construction decision
physical_objects.use: A racer can keep “make this Needleback quicker out of the bend”; a breeder can keep “add synchronization”; a collector can keep an appearance target.
physical_objects.decision: Choose an intention without reserving every vaguely related animal or accepting a timed contract.
physical_objects.completion: Cross out or archive the completed intention while retaining the actual object and result.
physical_objects.boundary: It grants no stock, automatic diagnosis, hidden genetics or mandatory objective chain.

physical_objects.title: The first personally completed racer
physical_objects.physical_brief: An illustrated complete-host tin with a sheltered living compartment, shaped preparation wells, a numbered fitting sheet and room for a name and race number.
physical_objects.use: A Wrangloid sells a coherent starter project; the owner assembles and finishes it before or during a supported club visit.
physical_objects.decision: Choose silhouette, a recognizable racing intention and personal finish; use the guide or alter it.
physical_objects.completion: A named, physically fitted racer completes a first actual run. Victory is possible, not guaranteed.
physical_objects.boundary: A “starter” label does not require uninteresting native-only racing, a compulsory breeding tutorial or a guaranteed win.

physical_objects.title: Foundry bench-session card
physical_objects.physical_brief: A reusable work card placed beside the host cradle, with a clear allowance area and replaceable strips for quoted additional work.
physical_objects.use: Groups one useful visit into a comprehensible service rather than selling every interface gesture as a separate appointment.
physical_objects.decision: Try ready owned components, adjust a setup and compare within the stated session; approve new preparation or extra time explicitly.
physical_objects.completion: Leave with a committed build and a readable comparison, or restore the prior arrangement using the same retained material.
physical_objects.boundary: The allowance is finite physical service; no infinite live tests, free resource refills or exemption from care outside its terms.

physical_objects.title: Paired build-comparison slip
physical_objects.physical_brief: Two adjacent silhouettes of the same racer or specified compared hosts, with the changed anatomy outlined and the finish result printed first.
physical_objects.use: Connects an ordinary swap to something the player can see and understand without demanding a laboratory report.
physical_objects.decision: Keep the improvement, revise the actual cause of the failure, or deliberately return to the earlier build.
physical_objects.completion: The owner can state what changed and what happened; old results remain frozen.
physical_objects.boundary: A different rival, body and surface cannot be presented as an isolated gene comparison. Replaying a slip is not new attendance.

physical_objects.title: A course invitation with useful construction information
physical_objects.physical_brief: A legible sectional course drawing with scale/connector notes in the margin, major surfaces distinguished, and a small space for the host club’s identity.
physical_objects.use: Lets a novice recognize a fast straight or short landing and lets a specialist inspect dimensions and contact opportunities.
physical_objects.decision: Choose a racer and configuration without receiving a secret list of mandatory branded components.
physical_objects.completion: The posted physical conditions match the course actually raced.
physical_objects.boundary: A structurally valid layout does not promise every build will finish. Illustrative counterplay is not an exhaustive solution list.

physical_objects.title: A purpose-led collecting brief
physical_objects.physical_brief: A field card combining a habitat sketch, one anatomical detail to protect, and the current project’s missing contribution.
records: What can be observed on site
physical_objects.use: Connects a component desire to a place and a particular kind of observation, not to a generic rare-drop icon.
physical_objects.decision: Choose detail, quick-route representation or buying instead; within the outing choose an individual and preservation method.
physical_objects.completion: Returns actual stock and reusable knowledge, including an honest result when the desired specimen was not found.
physical_objects.boundary: A project cannot rewrite the source population or certify an unmeasured trait; quick mode cannot duplicate the same available cohort.

physical_objects.title: Return tray with explicit competing uses
physical_objects.physical_brief: A divided receiving tray whose removable labels read Use, Research, Replacement, Ordinary sale and Display; each real specimen occupies one physical holding location.
physical_objects.use: Supports fast handling of ordinary volume and deliberate review of a few promising or personally valued animals.
physical_objects.decision: Choose a use based on purpose rather than one global quality number; move a specimen between plans deliberately.
physical_objects.completion: A completed batch leaves ownership, anatomy, care and cash mutually consistent.
physical_objects.boundary: Several possible uses are not several copies. “Sale candidate” is not already sold, and unmeasured does not mean bad.

physical_objects.title: Split-brood project and production card
physical_objects.physical_brief: A cohort label mounted on the actual enclosure, with separate bands for the current stage, the target contribution, and planned mature-stock destinations.
physical_objects.use: Keeps a longer breeding project intelligible while existing racers and ordinary output remain useful now.
physical_objects.decision: Continue a research branch, fill a replacement gap, use an intermediate or sell appropriate surplus.
physical_objects.completion: Records an observed milestone without calling every nonpremium animal a failed project.
physical_objects.boundary: Disposition numbers are intentions, not promised sexes, survival, genotype or receipts; the model cannot invent an absent compatible pair.

physical_objects.title: Care and maintenance agreement
physical_objects.physical_brief: A durable enclosure/case label with the responsible caretaker and supplied conditions on its face, with the next real handoff written on a replaceable strip.
physical_objects.use: Lets a hobbyist keep a stable or production line without manually operating every routine.
physical_objects.decision: Select research, production or maintenance; obtain suitable boarding or handling where useful.
physical_objects.completion: The animals remain in real supported care while the owner pursues another activity.
physical_objects.boundary: No universal preservation rule, selective frozen world clock, automatic regrowth or hidden unpaid service is implied.

physical_objects.title: A clean stopping point
physical_objects.physical_brief: A bookmark in the player’s project book or a card resting on the racer case; the front shows the completed achievement rather than warning icons.
physical_objects.use: Supports ending and resuming a session without a memory test or a housekeeping ritual.
physical_objects.decision: Keep the intention, change it, or do something else when returning.
physical_objects.completion: The player can stop after a satisfying action with the world’s state preserved and default offline time paused.
physical_objects.boundary: No streak, missed-login penalty, fabricated catch or retroactive care bill creates the reason to return.

physical_objects.title: A readable part card with actual progress
physical_objects.physical_brief: A prepared-sect tag that leads with the anatomical silhouette and functional name. Measurements sit beneath their purpose; identity and detailed provenance are on the reverse.
records: Compared change on the chosen purpose
physical_objects.use: Shows why a particular part is useful even when it has not crossed the next qualification boundary.
physical_objects.decision: Use, retain, improve, sell or compare the component for a named construction.
physical_objects.completion: A meaningful measured improvement is visible without secretly changing performance to match a new label.
physical_objects.boundary: One score cannot substitute for geometry, rarity, breeding value, condition, appearance and all race purposes.

physical_objects.title: A set as a sequence of usable changes
physical_objects.physical_brief: An exploded overlay aligned to the existing host, with each real component shown once and its separate function marked.
physical_objects.use: A coordinated set offers an enjoyable complete project but also intelligible intermediate upgrades when its pieces are acquired separately.
physical_objects.decision: Build the supplied set or take one useful conversion while retaining other native anatomy.
physical_objects.completion: Each declared intermediate is a functional animal, and the final set has an identifiable mechanical purpose.
physical_objects.boundary: No invisible same-brand aura; no duplicate tissue for multiple roles; a partial set is not automatically worthless.

physical_objects.title: Customer-owned-stock fitting brief
physical_objects.physical_brief: A work envelope containing the customer’s host and component identities, a drawing of the desired change and a signed handling boundary.
physical_objects.use: Allows an expert builder to earn with skills and facilities before financing a breeding and retail operation.
physical_objects.decision: Accept achievable fitting work, request suitable missing stock, or decline an unsupported promise.
physical_objects.completion: Performed work, observations and the same assets return to the customer for the agreed fee.
physical_objects.boundary: No guaranteed victory, genome improvement or sale of client-owned material without explicit permission.

physical_objects.title: A quote that separates the business being sold
physical_objects.physical_brief: A simple counter sheet with separate columns for discovery/design, repeat product work, client property, and cash due.
physical_objects.use: Prevents an attractive gross payment from concealing a loss-making repeat operation or falsely billing every research expense as per-unit production.
physical_objects.decision: Choose a fit-only job, complete manufacturing, living-stock supply or no order.
physical_objects.completion: The seller can identify what work earns the margin and what risks remain outside the quote.
physical_objects.boundary: No arbitrary reclassification of the old 150-credit example; no unsupported claim that future scale makes a negative margin profitable.

physical_objects.title: Useful ordinary supply lot
physical_objects.physical_brief: A tank or tray label with a modest product sketch and a clear acceptance statement; no premium pedigree crest is required.
physical_objects.use: Supplies beginner kits, routine repairs, alternative preparations and affordable projects from appropriate nonpremium stock.
physical_objects.decision: Sell now, prepare for a real order, or retain for a different purpose.
physical_objects.completion: An accepted physical lot changes owner for an actual payment.
physical_objects.boundary: Every unwanted animal need not have a profitable outlet. Damaged stock cannot be disguised as intact standard supply.

physical_objects.title: The product comes back as a recognizable relationship
physical_objects.physical_brief: A customer’s labelled build photograph or illustration attached to the actual product receipt, with a brief note about its use and permission to display it.
records: Budget if a new agreement exists
physical_objects.use: A kit maker can see the same stock in somebody else’s construction; a collector can see commissioned work displayed.
physical_objects.decision: Respond with fitting advice, a revision, replacement stock, another agreed product or no further transaction.
physical_objects.completion: The delivered asset has a visible downstream use while the producer’s reference remains intact.
physical_objects.boundary: The card is not automatic five-star praise, a forced sale, a universal reputation multiplier or proof that a genetic line caused a win.

physical_objects.title: Persistent club programme beside special editions
physical_objects.physical_brief: A wall card or handbill separating ordinary open sessions, a published special event, display dates and the championship route.
physical_objects.use: Makes a world-popular hobby available beyond a few finite prize editions, with practical occasions to use different constructions.
physical_objects.decision: Race casually, enter an actual funded competition, book a workshop, display work or help host.
physical_objects.completion: A declared activity delivers its result; ordinary participation continues when a special purse ends.
physical_objects.boundary: A recurring programme is not an infinite unbacked prize pool or a mandatory real-world appointment.

physical_objects.title: An honest collection identity
physical_objects.physical_brief: A case label composed around the creature or original material: the title is prominent, provenance and replacement history are legible, and technical detail does not cover the object.
physical_objects.use: Supports finishing, restoration, collections and pride in old work without inventing a speed justification.
physical_objects.decision: Present a particular aspect, seek a complementary piece, commission a finish or leave the object private.
physical_objects.completion: A coherent collection or finished piece exists as the outcome, whether or not it is sold.
physical_objects.boundary: A striking pattern is not automatically heritable, historically authentic or a championship-quality component.

period_bridges.title: A part becomes an observable change
period_bridges.chain: Actual prepared part → personal fit → useful visible behavior → real result → optional next acquisition or publication
period_bridges.same_object: The host, physical component, inherited observations and configuration version.
period_bridges.immediate_completion: One useful fit/run or an understood unsuccessful change.
period_bridges.longer_interest: A new component, better source stock, a different set or a commissioned construction.
period_bridges.optionality: No breeding, sale or publication is required to enjoy the run.

period_bridges.title: A field clue becomes a purposeful brood
period_bridges.chain: Existing habitat/individual → contextual cue → capture preserving useful anatomy → complementary parent or direct sect → actual kit behavior
period_bridges.same_object: The donor identity, observed cue, reproductive history and allocated anatomy.
period_bridges.immediate_completion: Return with a useful animal or meaningful source knowledge; no exact rare outcome promised.
period_bridges.longer_interest: Improve the missing contribution or establish a repeated preparation line.
period_bridges.optionality: The captured animal can be used, sold or displayed without breeding it.

period_bridges.title: A mixed generation supports both ambition and an ordinary livelihood
period_bridges.chain: Complementary founders → supported brood → observed dispositions → ordinary accepted product or retained candidate → paid useful output or personal assembly
period_bridges.same_object: Actual parents, distinct offspring, physical products and funded buyer demand.
period_bridges.immediate_completion: One selection milestone or usable intermediate product.
period_bridges.longer_interest: A more repeatable line, broader supply, or a better personal racer.
period_bridges.optionality: Research and ordinary production can share a line without requiring every offspring to be sold or certified.

period_bridges.title: A finished construction becomes somebody else’s project
period_bridges.chain: Personal reference build → bounded product promise → different actual host/components → funded kit → recipient assembly/use → optional revised request
period_bridges.same_object: The reference remains intact; the sold kit has its own actual host and source parts.
period_bridges.immediate_completion: A product is delivered, then has a recognizable downstream use.
period_bridges.longer_interest: A signature edition, a new customer, more suitable stock or a revised construction.
period_bridges.optionality: A championship is not required to make a useful kit; a finished delivery does not force another order.

period_bridges.title: An owned course becomes a social reason to use another build
period_bridges.chain: Owned sections → declared layout → practice/rivals or funded event → actual race/display result → next local meeting or voluntary redesign
period_bridges.same_object: Section identities, laid version, physical racers, programme and actual results.
period_bridges.immediate_completion: A usable constructed course or a completed meeting.
period_bridges.longer_interest: Another arrangement, shared section collection, a racing specialty or a hosted occasion.
period_bridges.optionality: Trackmaking does not require a breeding career, and player geometry does not mint official qualification.

period_bridges.title: A valuable collection remains enjoyable rather than becoming only overhead
period_bridges.chain: Chosen specimen/build → finish or collection arrangement → supported care/display → owner-permitted recognition → optional new visual or sporting project
period_bridges.same_object: The particular animal, natural features, applied work and historical provenance.
period_bridges.immediate_completion: A finished piece worth keeping or a meaningful display.
period_bridges.longer_interest: A complementary specimen, restoration, another printed edition or a different race campaign.
period_bridges.optionality: No performance or cash reward is required to justify the collection, and default offline pause permits stopping.

worked_paths.title: Buy, build and race without a second occupation
phase_connection: 0-5: complete personal kit and understandable performance
10-15: club result, comparison and optional public identity
steps: Choose a Tin Can Special or an appropriate founder-style kit by appearance, contents and intended racing—not by a forced introductory production class.
Assemble the supplied anatomy, retain the explicit native roles, name and finish the host. The guide has complete build checkpoints rather than requiring the entire catalogue learned first.
Use a booked bench session to inspect one useful setting and take an ordinary run. No donor breeding, product publication or assay certificate is a prerequisite.
Celebrate the actual finish. If the run suggests a desired change, compare one ready part or setup and leave with a committed construction.
Record an optional next intention: a rival challenge, a shop comparison, a field source, a visual finish or nothing yet.
completion_conditions: A personally completed, recognizable racer exists.
A real run/result exists; the first run need not be a win.
The user can choose a next interest without accepting all deeper systems.
worked_paths.meaningful_failure: The build can lose. Clear feedback and an affordable existing-part comparison provide a possible response; no automatic winner buff is granted.
worked_paths.clean_stopping_point: The fitted host and its chosen care remain recorded; no ongoing brood or commission was silently created.
worked_paths.not_claimed: No measured onboarding time, first-run success rate or player-retention gain is asserted.

worked_paths.title: A targeted capture becomes an intermediate build and a breeding project
phase_connection: 10-15: spatial source, living-breeder customer and compendium action detail
starting_objects: A high-return Hopper founder or access to one
An identified Switchyard source and realistic case capacity
steps: Choose synchronization as the missing contribution. Read the existing habitat brief; do not alter the population’s genes to suit that target.
Observe a candidate’s paired release under its visible conditions, approach it and protect its useful anatomy. A good field cue remains uncertain evidence.
At home, compare controlled evidence if the decision warrants it. Keep the candidate as a possible parent instead of demanding premium return from that same individual.
Plan research review, ordinary components and a bounded replacement target before starting a supported brood. Offspring and compatible roles are not guaranteed.
When individuals exist and are observed, allocate useful intermediates to a personal assembly or real ordinary buyer. Retain the particular candidates that advance the next target.
Fit an actual descendant’s preparation or continue using the existing racer while selection continues. A later recipient sees the same physical output, not a gene unlocked by progress.
completion_conditions: The catch has a specific plausible purpose.
At least one actual observed project milestone can be recorded independently of perfect offspring.
Each animal and source region has one current use.
worked_paths.meaningful_failure: A wrong role, failed pairing, poor expression or damaged anatomy can matter. The plan permits another founder or buying useful stock; it does not force a convenient brood.
worked_paths.clean_stopping_point: Stop new starts when the chosen reserve is full or demand is absent. Living stock continues under agreed care; offline time pauses.
worked_paths.not_claimed: No multigeneration success probability or profitable-brood guarantee is implied.

worked_paths.title: Earn through construction before financing every source
phase_connection: 5-10: real stock and useful controlled comparison
10-15: customer purpose, quote and recipient record
starting_objects: A customer’s prepared drive and contact set
steps: The customer describes the desired improvement and authorizes handling of its particular stock. The fitter checks whether the current construction can reasonably address that goal.
Quote performed fitting and comparison work. Identify material supplied by the client separately from any item the fitter must purchase.
Use a bounded session to adjust the actual release/drive relationship or root arrangement. Preserve the reference until the new commitment is approved.
Test under declared conditions. A negative result can complete the agreed diagnostic service but cannot be sold as an achieved speed improvement.
Return the same animal and stock with the agreed result. Payment follows the actual service contract.
The fitter may spend realized income on a personally owned part, obtain breeding stock, or continue serving clients.
completion_conditions: A low-capital non-breeding livelihood has a defined product.
Customer stock returns in its authorized condition/custody.
The claimed result matches the work actually done.
worked_paths.meaningful_failure: The client may reject an unsupported guarantee; a part may not fit; the fitter can decline or revise before spending irreversible stock.
worked_paths.clean_stopping_point: The completed service has no automatically renewed deadline or hidden ownership claim on the client’s animal.
worked_paths.not_claimed: No new fees or expected hourly income are calibrated here.

worked_paths.title: A signature construction reaches a real recipient
phase_connection: 0-5: named host, component functions, complete project
10-15: measured recipe, alternate-stock kit, recipient and genuine new demand
starting_objects: A product specification with explicit purpose
Another actual host and qualifying components
steps: Publish the intended construction requirements and allowed mechanisms without transferring any of the reference racer’s anatomy.

Separate prior experimentation from the repeat job. Quote the actual product inputs, preparation, care, work and delivery; do not assume retail-purchased inputs become profitable through a recipe label.
Select another host and different physical parts. A substitute must satisfy its functional measurements and whole-build fit, not merely a higher band.
Pack with the declared care and actual source allocation. Deliver only the promised physical inventory for the agreed payment.
The recipient opens and personally assembles those same contents. A later note identifies actual use: racing, display, or an issue needing fitting assistance.

A repeat request exists only when the customer has another actual purpose and funds. It may request a revised release range, another host fit or a matching visual edition; no automatic popularity dividend is paid.
completion_conditions: The sold kit contains real alternate stock and a usable guide.
The recipient’s actual purpose closes the product loop.
worked_paths.meaningful_failure: A technically completed order can still lose money, as W12’s route did. Preserve that result, investigate real cost categories and decline an unsuitable repeat rather than add a subsidy disguised as reputation.
worked_paths.clean_stopping_point: The maker keeps the product knowledge and any explicitly retained stock; completed orders create no permanent reserve on all future output.
worked_paths.not_claimed: No autonomous customer simulation or profitable pricing is claimed as delivered.

worked_paths.title: Course ownership becomes useful public work
phase_connection: 0-5: modular racing reference and distinct handling parts
5-10: owned Trackworks sections and brake/guide source functions
10-15: club programme, services and clear recognition
starting_objects: Owned or explicitly borrowed circuit sections
A usable venue and setup brief
Entrants with their own actual builds
steps: Design a closed route for the stated audience. Identify real speed, turn, surface, contact and landing opportunities rather than secretly requiring one proprietary set.
Publish the actual layout, key conditions and event purpose. An exhibition, practice session and official qualifier have different consequences.
Make several plausible responses available through existing stock or setup: landing length, approach, ratio, material, alternate line or a suitable different racer.
Host the meeting. A handling component’s effect is credited only during its actual action; ordinary racing still emphasizes pace and finishing.
Settle the stated setup work or funded prizes. Participants can recognize the builder and request another real layout occasion without making every replay payable.
Archive the construction knowledge and retain the actual section ownership. An ordinary club programme continues beyond one sponsored edition.
completion_conditions: The course is a real completed construction.
Its special features create legible optional decisions.
Hosting and racing rewards have distinct funded purposes.
worked_paths.meaningful_failure: A structurally valid course can be unsuitable for a particular racer. The designer revises or advertises the challenge honestly; no validation rule guarantees every entry finishes.
worked_paths.clean_stopping_point: The setup is complete and the result recorded; the next event is an available choice, not a real-world attendance obligation.
worked_paths.not_claimed: No expanded geometry solver, four-roach physics or new official qualification is implemented by this reference.

worked_paths.title: A beautiful specimen is a complete reason to participate
phase_connection: 5-10: distinct live specimen and ordinary commercial stock
10-15: field recognition, display institutions, provenance and current compendium
starting_objects: An existing collection or an affordable empty display project
A source or Wrangloid with an appealing actual specimen
Suitable ongoing care or structural-material storage
steps: Choose a visual or historical goal without assigning it a race-stat target. Identify what is natural, applied or claimed.
Catch, buy or commission the actual object. Select preservation and handling for the anatomy or appearance being valued.
Prepare the case or finish the construction while maintaining the object’s necessary working and care conditions.
Write an honest display label distinguishing original specimen, descendant, applied finish and reproduced edition.
Show it at an available club display, keep it privately or offer it to a relevant funded customer. A visible compliment is not a genetically certified price increase.
Preserve the finished project and choose whether to pursue a complementary piece, a racing conversion, restoration or no further action.
completion_conditions: Acquisition and finishing produce an actual kept object.
Display and recognition have a purpose independent of race victory.
Its history survives optional later rebuilding.
worked_paths.meaningful_failure: An appealing claim may lack evidence or a specimen may not suit the intended handling. The collector can decline or choose a different purpose without receiving a false stat consolation.
worked_paths.clean_stopping_point: The project is complete and its care plan is known. No compulsory daily display or bonus-maintenance sequence is attached.
worked_paths.not_claimed: Inherited appearance prevalence, collector pricing and human attachment remain untested.

amendments.disposition: Replace the conflicting qualitative interpretation; retain old experimental records and inputs unchanged.
amendments.preserve: All activities share useful physical stock.
