editorial_cases.situation: A buyer uses a kit and local bench/course without touching breeding, pedigree certification or fieldwork.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: No mandatory detour; personally completed project and real race remain possible.

editorial_cases.situation: A low-return, good-synchrony Hopper is compared against a missing-synchrony project.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: Its potential contribution is recognized without claiming the final individual is already superior.

editorial_cases.situation: Two unknown genomes have the same visible evidence.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: Default recommendations and ordinary price evidence do not distinguish their hidden truth.

editorial_cases.situation: A productive line has a full replacement target and another successful brood.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: The policy does not silently add two more permanent replacement animals; choices remain explicit.

editorial_cases.situation: Ordinary output exceeds the currently funded buyer quantity.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: Unsold stock remains real care; production can pause without erasing existing lives.

editorial_cases.situation: Equal-burden stock is genuinely better on useful axes.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: No unrelated drawback is invented solely to force a sidegrade.

editorial_cases.situation: One waxmoth fatbody is offered as both full reservoir and full Keel.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: The source cannot be allocated twice; two real preparations need disjoint material.

editorial_cases.situation: The player repositions ready owned anatomy and previews another setting repeatedly.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: Draft work does not charge repeated attendance; actual fitting/testing respects the bounded service and physical costs.

editorial_cases.situation: A part crosses a display threshold without any physical or observational change.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: A label cannot improve anatomy or establish a new measured result.

editorial_cases.situation: An accepted 112-credit product requires 150 credits of actual new payments.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: The -38 change is retained, not cured through a reputation aura or unearned stock valuation.

editorial_cases.situation: A successful construction is reproduced for sale.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: The reference keeps its parts; the recipient receives another actual host and appropriate stock.

editorial_cases.situation: A finite sponsored edition is exhausted.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: Ordinary club participation persists; no old purse is repaid or erased.

editorial_cases.situation: A paused two-roach prototype cannot support a depicted aerial event.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: The compendium may define the intended sport, but no runtime or physics completion is asserted.

editorial_cases.situation: A beautiful ordinary moth has no speed advantage.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: Collection and finishing remain complete purposes with honest labels.

editorial_cases.situation: The player leaves after pausing future starts.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: No unplayed days advance costs, mortality or profits under the default paused-world branch.

editorial_cases.situation: A stored native component was consumed earlier.
editorial_cases.expected_definition: Neither a recipe nor a session service recreates it; replacement or explicit regeneration rules are required.

future_comparison_studies.question: Does the bench-session model improve understood experimentation without concealing physical costs?
future_comparison_studies.compare: Per-small-action appointments versus a bounded useful bench session.
future_comparison_studies.control: Same starting host, stock, total physical service opportunity, information and achievable builds; record differences in actual spending rather than secretly subsidize one variant.
observe: Correct explanation of one changed mechanism
Whether participants willingly try a second variation
future_comparison_studies.rejection: If users cannot distinguish real new work from free draft manipulation, or the session merely hides higher costs, revise it.

future_comparison_studies.question: Can players identify a useful candidate without an oracle or an obligatory assay for every catch?
future_comparison_studies.compare: All useful traits hidden until assay versus contextual visible cues plus targeted precise tests.
future_comparison_studies.control: Same source population, individual truths, capture conditions, prices and hidden variables; change only the public evidence layer.
observe: Willingness to revisit a familiar source
Ability to recognize a complement rather than strongest individual
future_comparison_studies.rejection: If visible cues become exact-genome or price oracles, or no novice can make an informed decision, revise the information hierarchy.
future_comparison_studies.scope: Future human and content review; not performed.

future_comparison_studies.question: Does useful intermediate output support strategy without removing meaningful risk?
future_comparison_studies.compare: Single premium pass/fail goal versus split-brood objectives with bounded replacements and the same actual offspring.
future_comparison_studies.control: Same parents, outcome sequence, costs, capacities and buyers; distinguish decisions from differences in favorable random outcomes.
observe: Understanding of failed attempts and unknown descendants
future_comparison_studies.rejection: If the polished plan silently selects hidden perfect genomes or deletes excess animals, it fails regardless of reported convenience.

future_comparison_studies.question: Which livelihood is affordable under matched resources, and what does its buyer actually value?
future_comparison_studies.compare: Retail-supplied assembly, field-sourced manufacture, established-line production, and customer-owned-stock fitting as distinct offerings.
future_comparison_studies.control: Matched starting capital and action opportunity; disclose facilities, source assets, research allocation, care, outcome uncertainty, target quality and funded demand. Do not compare an endowed mature business to a new builder without adjustment.
observe: Buyer purpose and willingness to purchase
future_comparison_studies.rejection: A model that loses money per repeated accepted unit cannot be called an earning-a-keep route because its first sale is visually pleasing.
future_comparison_studies.scope: Future economic calibration and human study; not performed.

future_comparison_studies.question: Does each advertised construction repeatedly express a visible useful action without fake results?
future_comparison_studies.compare: Matched baseline/candidate components and relevant versus irrelevant opportunity contexts.
future_comparison_studies.control: Hold host, relevant setup, course and competitors fixed for one-component claims; separately examine complete build concepts without calling them isolated tests.
observe: Whether observers identify the fitted anatomy
Desire to rerace beyond prize exhaustion
future_comparison_studies.rejection: Do not rescue a rarely working flagship ability with an automatic pass, unseen multiplier, or a course that only that item can finish.
future_comparison_studies.scope: Future downstream implementation and human study; not performed.

future_comparison_studies.question: Do players return for self-chosen projects rather than avoidable upkeep or expiration pressure?
future_comparison_studies.compare: An obligation-led reentry versus a completed result plus one chosen next intention and optional expert state.
future_comparison_studies.control: Same saved world, care rules, offline pause, available projects and rewards; no streak or artificial scarcity advantage in either version.
observe: What the player intends to do next
Time spent rediscovering the current goal
Projects finished rather than merely accumulated
Reasons for voluntary stopping and returning
Enjoyment distinct from total time spent
future_comparison_studies.rejection: More session minutes do not count as success if they are caused by confusion, repeated administration or fear of losing stock.

historical_cash_case.interpretation: Arithmetic retained from the earlier authored experiment, not rerun. The available summary does not isolate research expenditure, retail inputs and repeated unit costs. Do not recategorize all negative cash as investment by assumption.

historical_stock_case.interpretation: One historical seed and policy, not a causal study. It supports examining retained-stock and demand constraints, not claiming that retention alone caused the cash change.

evidence_states: future human and runtime evaluation open

MIVIM.objective: Join the three development periods into a hobby whose short completed pleasures support longer chosen projects, while every part retains its PCR-derived purpose and living source.
MIVIM.comparator: Many correct local subsystems connected as a compulsory serial gauntlet, with prototype fees, finite content, opaque evidence and unbounded retained stock determining participation.
MIVIM.hard_gate: Required quality at declared compendium scope AND adherence to purposeful novel integration. Neither is offset by length, speed, counts or mechanical checks.

assessment.finding: Explicit replacement definitions, retained source facts, linked objects and comparison cases are authored. Documentary completeness and cross-reference checks support reviewability.
assessment.limit: This does not certify final game quality; human comprehension and interaction costs require downstream observation.

assessment.finding: Project-specific integration is concrete: bounded bench visits, complementary-stock loops, target-based replacements, separate maker businesses, recipient recognition and a persistent ordinary sport share the same physical objects.
assessment.limit: No worldwide-novelty or prior-art exhaustiveness claim; standard tools support a specific whole.

assessment.finding: The written systems answer the identified dependency, selection, cost and continuity problems at specification scope.
assessment.limit: Expected experiential improvement remains a hypothesis. No new gameplay, retention or profitability test was run.

assessment.finding: The revised connections preserve living material, hand-built kits, insects, clubs, breeders and distinct economic purposes rather than replacing them with generic XP or rarity loops.
assessment.limit: Whether players experience them as distinctive or pleasurable is not established by the author’s judgment alone.

assessment.finding: Shared source/product/evidence/care distinctions and repeatable object briefs allow new donors and communities to use a coherent design language.
assessment.limit: No runtime scale, autonomous national economy, large-agent retrieval benchmark or real player population has been measured.

MIVIM.research_boundary: Empirical papers, developer accounts and reference-hobby documentation have different evidentiary roles. RRR proposals are inferences and authored decisions, not results copied from those sources.

Forced daily returns or expiration fear
Rarity score as substitute for meaningful anatomy

Tests and archive counts used as an engagement grade
Prototype limits treated as universe canon
